title: Social Media Manager / Marketing Assistant
description:
About Us

Watson Media House is a real estate media company in the United States. We shoot photography,

video, drone, and 3D tours for over 1,000 real estate agents across five markets. We deliver everything

within 24 hours. We are a small team and we care a lot about quality.



The Role

You will own our social media presence and support our marketing. You are not just scheduling posts.

You are d
 what we post and making it good.



What You'll Do



Content and posting

• Post daily across Instagram,
, and TikTok

• Write captions that sound like us, not like a template

• Find high-performing content ideas we can adapt, from other media companies, real estate

accounts, and outside the industry

• Track trending audio and formats and tell us what we should be doing

• Build and maintain a monthly content calendar

• Repurpose our shoot footage into reels, carousels, and stories



Working with our team

• Ask our photographers and editors for behind-the-scenes footage, wins, and stories each week

• Chase the material down, do not wait for it to show up

• Keep a running bank of usable content so we are never scrambling

Client social media accounts

• Find and log content ideas tailored to each agent whose social media we manage

• Build a running content bank per client so we always have material ready

• Match content style and tone to each agent's brand and audience

• Track what performs for each client and adjust



Engagement and DM outreach

• Respond to comments and DMs daily

• Send daily DMs to agents from lists we provide

• Follow up with warm responses until they book or say no

• Log every conversation and outcome

• Stay within our daily send limits to protect account health

• Engage with agent and brokerage accounts so we stay visible



GoHighLevel and marketing support

• Build and schedule
 campaigns

• Maintain contact lists, tags, and segments

• Set up and monitor automations and workflows

• Build landing pages for offers and campaigns

• Basic reporting on opens, clicks, and conversions



Reporting

• Weekly numbers: posts published, reach, engagement, follower growth, DMs sent, warm

responses, leads generated

• Tell us what worked and what did not



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years managing social media for a business, not just personal accounts

• Strong written English. You will write captions and message American real estate agents

• A real eye for what makes content good. This is the most important thing

• Canva, CapCut or similar, and comfortable in scheduling tools

• Comfortable using AI tools daily, especially Claude. You will use it for caption drafts, content

research, campaign copy, and summarizing performance data. We are not looking for someone

who pastes AI output straight to the feed. We want someone who uses it to work faster and then

makes it sound human

• GoHighLevel experience is a big plus. If you do not have it, you need to be able to learn it fast

• Organized and self-directed. We are on US Central time and you will not have someone watching

over you

• Reliable internet and a quiet workspace



Nice To Have

• Real estate or home services experience

• Basic video editing

• Familiarity with Aryeo or similar platforms



Details

• Starting at 30 hours per week, with room to grow to full time. 12PM - 6PM CST, Monday - Friday

• Some overlap with US Central business hours required

• Paid monthly

• Long-term position. We want someone who grows with us



To Apply

Send the following:

1. Links to two or three social accounts you have managed

2. Three captions you wrote that you are proud of

3. One example of content from another brand you think is excellent, and why

4. Your experience with GoHighLevel, if any

5. How you currently use AI in your work. Give one specific example, and tell us how you make sure

the output does not sound like AI

Applications without numbers 3 and 5 will not be reviewed.

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Production Lead / Project Manager (Video + Ads) – Remote (APAC)

Company: ZKP Location: Remote (preference for Philippines / APAC time zones with 3–4 hrs overlap with Brisbane)



About ZKP

We build and run the Money Printer marketing system for Australian buyers agents and mortgage brokers. We fly in, film for 2 days, build the funnel, launch Meta ads, and guarantee 15 qualified investor discovery calls in 90 days.

We’re a small, sharp team that cares about results, not fluff.



The Role

We’re looking for a Production Lead / Project Manager who will own our 14‑day Money Printer sprints from sold to launched.

Your job: keep editors, videographer, copywriter and GHL/tech moving, and make sure every asset is quality checked before it hits the client.

This is an internal ops + QC role, not a client-facing account manager role.



What You’ll Own

Your success is measured by:

* On‑time launches: 90% of sprints launched on or before the adjusted 14‑day target.

* Low rework: Paid assets (VSL, pre‑call, ads) average ≤ 1.5 revision rounds.

* Clean delivery: Fewer than 2 client‑caught QC errors per client per month.



Key Responsibilities

* Run the daily sprint standup: walk each active client through stages, call out bottlenecks, assign next actions.

* Maintain the Sprint Board (ClickUp/Notion/ClipFlow): stages, owners, SLAs, due dates, status.

* QC all video and ad assets before they go to our videographer or client:

* Check framing, captions, audio, aspect ratios, pacing, branding, disclaimers.

* Coordinate with:

* Editors (post‑production timelines and deliverables)

* Videographer (shoot handover, ingest, ClipFlow labelling)

* GHL/tech (funnels, automations, tracking wired before launch)

* Media buyer (campaigns built and tested before go‑live)

* Enforce approve‑by‑default rules and track revision counts.

* Update and improve checklists and SOPs when something breaks.



Requirements

* 3+ years in video / creative production coordination or project management (agency, production house, or similar).

* Hands‑on experience managing multiple editors or creatives at once.

* Strong understanding of video basics: sequences, exports, formats for social, captions, lower thirds.

* Very strong written and spoken English.

* Obsessed with details, organization, and hitting deadlines.

* Comfortable chasing people and holding them to SLAs.



Nice to Have

* Experience with Meta ads, GHL/GoHighLevel, ClipFlow or similar tools.

* Experience with finance / real estate / professional services brands.



What We Offer

* Competitive AUD salary, depending on experience (full‑time, long‑term).

* Fully remote role with a tight, no‑drama team.

* Clear scorecard and ownership: you run the sprint, we back you.

* Chance to grow into a senior operations role as we scale.



How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. A brief note on your experience managing video or creative production.

3. A 3–5 minute Loom video walking through:

* A project you managed with multiple creatives.

* The tools you used (boards, trackers).

* How you handled QC and deadlines.



Subject line: “Production Lead – [Your Name]”.

title: SENIOR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR TO FOUNDER
description:
Location: Philippines, remote



Position: Full-time



Schedule: Monday to Friday, with meaningful overlap with New York business hours



Compensation: monthly, depending on experience and demonstrated ability





ABOUT THE ROLE



I am looking for an exceptionally sharp, trustworthy and resourceful person to become my operational right hand across several businesses, client engagements and personal responsibilities.



I am developing systems, applications and automations to manage inboxes, projects, client requests and recurring work. Your role will not be to perform every task manually. You will help ensure that the right systems are in place, information is flowing through them correctly and people are using them consistently.



You will act as my second set of eyes. You will make sure requests are acknowledged, approved actions are completed, deadlines are tracked, follow-ups happen and nothing important is quietly sitting unanswered.



We will create and maintain standard operating procedures for recurring work. You will help document how things should be handled, follow those procedures, identify where they are unclear or incomplete and help improve them as our businesses grow.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role. I need someone who can think, organize, check, follow through and learn quickly. You will not be expected to know how to do everything immediately. What matters is that you are intelligent, curious, careful and genuinely eager to learn and develop.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



Systems, SOPs and Quality Control

Act as My Second Set of Eyes

• Check that client requests have been captured, acknowledged and assigned correctly



• Review
s, documents and deliverables for clarity, accuracy and completeness

Client Requests and Approved Actions



• Monitor the systems through which client questions and requests are received



• Confirm that clients receive timely acknowledgements and responses

• Send follow-ups, schedule meetings, update records and coordinate next steps

• Track each request until it is fully resolved



• Escalate technical, accounting, tax, legal, financial or sensitive decisions rather than making unauthorized decisions



• Keep clear records of approvals, actions taken and outstanding matters





Project and Team Coordination



• Convert my
s, meetings, voice notes and ideas into clear tasks and next steps

Campaigns and Business Development

 campaigns, funnels, follow-up sequences and launches

Prior marketing or funnel experience is helpful but not required. I am willing to teach the right person and provide access to training. You must be excited to learn new systems, tools and skills.





Personal and Confidential Support



• Assist with personal scheduling, appointments, reservations, research and administrative matters

• Help maintain timelines, correspondence and follow-ups relating to an ongoing divorce and other sensitive family matters



• Coordinate approved communications with attorneys and other professionals



• Keep personal, client, financial and legal information strictly confidential



• Share sensitive information only with authorized individuals



This role does not involve providing legal, tax, accounting or financial advice. It requires careful organization, discretion and reliable follow-through.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• There is a clear and documented process for recurring work

• Client requests are captured, acknowledged, approved and completed

s and other communications receive appropriate responses

• You become increasingly capable of managing recurring responsibilities independently





WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You will be a strong fit if you:



• Have at least three years of experience supporting a founder, executive or senior professional



• Have experience in executive assistance, project coordination, operations or client service

-marketing platforms

COMPENSATION AND OPPORTUNITY

HOW TO APPLY

2. A video of no more than three minutes introducing yourself and explaining why this position fits you



3. Your location, availability, preferred working hours and expected monthly compensation

description:
Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)





THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.



Must-have:

-Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

-AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

- Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

-Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

-Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.



Nice to have:

-You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

-You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

-You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

-You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

-You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

-You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

-You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

-You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

-You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

title: Short-Form Video Creator / Animator — AI & Stop-Motion
description:
Gig / Project-Based — Potential for Ongoing Part-Time Work



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a creative short-form video creator / animator to help us bring our brand mascot and social media content to life.



This starts as a paid trial project, with strong potential to grow into ongoing part-time work for the right person.

You'll work closely with a small internal team, including our Head of SEO and Head of AI, to help build our brand's video presence across social media.



We're looking for someone who can do more than simply follow instructions. We want a creative partner who can help us develop ideas, experiment with formats, and consistently turn concepts into engaging, publish-ready videos.

THE IMMEDIATE PROJECT: BRINGING "BOB" TO LIFE



Our immediate focus is our brand mascot, Bob — a physical plush character we're developing into a recognizable personality for social media.

We're looking to create short, funny, relatable, and emotionally engaging videos featuring Bob, generally in the 15–30 second range, for platforms such as Instagram and TikTok.

The creative direction is inspired by character-driven content such as The Tiny Chef Show — simple situations, strong personality, humor, and storytelling.



We're open to different production approaches, including:

• Traditional stop-motion / claymation

• AI-generated video

• 3D animation

• Hybrid AI + traditional animation

• Other creative approaches that can produce consistent, high-quality results

The goal is not to use a particular tool — the goal is to make Bob feel like a real character that people want to watch and follow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Create short-form videos featuring our brand mascot and other brand concepts

• Develop and execute simple storylines, visual gags, and character-driven concepts

• Animate or generate character movement using the production method best suited to your workflow

• Maintain strong character consistency across scenes and videos

• Edit videos into polished, publish-ready content

• Handle pacing, cuts, captions, text overlays, sound effects, music, and basic audio synchronization

• Collaborate with our Head of SEO, Head of AI, and internal team on content ideas and strategy

• Help brainstorm new recurring formats and video concepts

• Iterate based on feedback and performance

• Eventually help us establish a repeatable video production process that can support multiple videos per week



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

AI Video Creation

• Experience creating short-form videos using AI video generation tools such as Kling, Runway, Veo, or similar

• Strong understanding of prompting, reference images, character consistency, and multi-shot workflows

• Ability to produce consistent results rather than relying on one-off generations

• Experience combining AI-generated clips with editing, voice, music, and sound effects



Stop-Motion / Animation

• Experience with stop-motion, claymation, puppetry, or character animation

• Experience animating physical objects, plush characters, or soft-bodied characters is a strong advantage

• Familiarity with tools such as Dragonframe, After Effects, Blender, or similar software

Video Editing / Content

• Strong short-form video editing skills

• Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, or similar platforms

• Good understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, and social-media-friendly formats

You do not need to have experience in every area above.

We're more interested in your portfolio, creativity, consistency, and ability to produce engaging videos than in a specific list of software you've used.



REQUIRED

• Portfolio or demo reel showing video, animation, or AI-generated video work that you personally created

• Please include a link to your portfolio/reel. Applications without relevant work samples may not be considered.

• Ability to create short-form videos consistently and meet agreed deadlines

• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on work

• Able to work collaboratively with a small remote team

• Reliable communication and availability during agreed working hours

• Your current equipment/software setup and the tools you use to create your work



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with AI video generation

• Experience maintaining consistency of the same character across multiple videos

• Stop-motion or claymation experience

• Experience animating plush, puppet, or physical characters

• Voiceover or audio-sync experience

• Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools

• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software

• Experience developing recurring social-media content series

• Experience creating branded or marketing content

• A strong understanding of what makes short-form content engaging and shareable



THE TRIAL PROJECT

The engagement will begin with a paid trial project involving 1–2 short mascot videos.

The purpose of the trial is to evaluate:

• Quality of the finished videos

• Ability to maintain Bob's appearance and personality

• Storytelling and creativity

• Production speed and estimated time per video

• Ability to work from a concept and develop it into a finished video

• Communication and responsiveness

• How well we work together

If the trial is successful and the fit works for both sides, we'd like the relationship to develop into ongoing part-time work.

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We're not looking for someone who can only complete a single project.

Our goal is to build an ongoing video content engine, potentially producing multiple short-form videos per week.

The person we bring on may eventually help us with:

• Recurring mascot content

• Social media campaigns

• Short-form educational or entertaining videos

• LinkedIn content

• AI-assisted video production

• New characters and creative formats

• Content experimentation and ideation

We're especially interested in someone who can grow with the role and eventually become a long-term creative partner for our video content.



COMPENSATION

Paid trial project.

Compensation for the trial and ongoing work will be discussed based on experience, portfolio, estimated production time, and scope.

For ongoing work, we're looking for a rate that can support a sustainable part-time monthly engagement.

HOURS

Initial engagement: Project-based

Potential ongoing engagement: Part-time, with hours to be determined based on fit, workload, and availability.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Portfolio / demo reel

2. Examples of short-form videos or character-based work

3. A brief description of your experience with AI video, animation, stop-motion, or video editing

4. The tools/software you typically use

5. Your hourly rate or expected project rate

6. Your approximate availability per week

Please lead with your portfolio/reel. We are primarily interested in seeing what you can create.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Contract



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses: roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops.



Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and profitable growth.



We’re hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What Makes This Role Different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand, including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You’ll build campaigns, write ads, make bid changes, and manage accounts directly. We’re moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few quarters, the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the systems mature, keep reading.



What You’ll Own



Your own book of clients. You’ll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You’ll manage Google Ads across home service accounts with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client’s phone is not ringing. You’ll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent, Viktor, provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them: which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when Performance Max is supporting the account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.



Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan for the next month.



What Success Looks Like



In your first 90 days, you’ll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account.



Longer term, success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What We’re Looking For



We care more about demonstrated results than years of experience, but this is not an entry-level role.



Must-Haves



Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, “the dashboard looks fine” is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

Strong communication skills. You’ll be in Slack daily.

Strong Pluses



Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to booked jobs

Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use them.

The Environment



Remote, international team

Contractor position, paid biweekly

Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience

Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you’ll begin earning an ongoing monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month for as long as the client stays.

Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor

You can work from anywhere in the world, but you must work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the Eastern Time schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working these hours, do not apply.

Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, which means the work has to be good.

Small, senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team.

title: Sales & Business Development Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

We receive a high volume of applications that use the same generic AI-generated language. If your application reads like a template, simply repeats this job description back to us, or gives generic answers that could have been sent to any employer, your application will not be considered.



AI may be used as a tool, but your application must reflect your real experience, judgment, communication style, and personality. We want to hear from you, not a polished generic application.



A voice recording is also required as part of the application process.



About Marketing Munster

Marketing Munster is a growing, founder-led marketing agency serving businesses primarily in the United States.

We provide a mix of marketing, lead generation, digital, advertising, CRM, automation, and growth services.

We are a small, entrepreneurial team. We move quickly, communicate directly, learn constantly, and expect people to take ownership of outcomes rather than simply complete assigned tasks.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a stronger and more consistent sales engine.



The Role

We are hiring a Sales & Business Development Specialist.

Your primary responsibility is simple:

Help create, manage, and close revenue opportunities.

This is not a position where you wait for someone to continuously tell you what task to complete next.

You will work both company-provided opportunities and opportunities you help create through prospecting, social media, partnerships, lead platforms, outbound outreach, referrals, reactivation, and other channels.

You may also support outreach campaigns for Marketing Munster clients.

This is a hands-on role involving prospecting, follow-up, appointment setting, sales conversations, pipeline management, partnership development,
 outreach, and eventually greater ownership over the sales process.



What You Will Own

Sales & Pipeline

You will help manage the full sales process, including:

* Responding to inbound leads

* Outbound prospecting

* Following up with leads consistently

* Qualifying prospects

* Booking sales appointments

* Conducting or supporting discovery calls

* Following up on proposals

* Helping move opportunities toward a yes or no

* Reactivating older leads

* Tracking opportunities in the CRM

* Identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities

* Supporting renewals

* Asking for referrals

* Helping build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline



Your job is not simply to make calls.

The goal is: Qualified conversations → appointments → opportunities → proposals → closed and collected revenue.



Social Media Prospecting & Partnership Development

We are especially interested in someone who has experience finding leads and opportunities through social media and online research.

You may be responsible for:

* Finding potential prospects through LinkedIn, Instagram,
, directories, online communities/groups, and other platforms

* Identifying businesses that fit our target markets

* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding strategic partnership opportunities

* Identifying influencers or creators for campaigns

* Conducting B2B outreach

* Conducting B2C outreach when appropriate

* Supporting influencer outreach

* Developing partnership conversations

* Following up with potential partners

* Working with our Social Media Manager to identify and pursue opportunities

* Turning social engagement and research into real conversations, appointments, partnerships, and revenue

We want someone who knows how to find opportunities, not just work from a list someone else gives them.



CRM, GoHighLevel &
 Outreach

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is strongly preferred.

You may be responsible for:

* Managing contacts and opportunities

* Updating CRM records

* Managing pipeline stages

* Following up with leads through
, SMS, and phone

* Creating or assisting with
 sequences

* Creating basic follow-up automations

* Segmenting contacts

* Monitoring responses

* Managing lead reactivation campaigns

* Helping build outbound
 campaigns

* Making sure leads do not fall through the cracks

Experience with
 outreach, automated follow-up, cold
, Apollo, and basic
 deliverability concepts is highly valuable.



You do not need to be an advanced automation engineer.

You do need to be comfortable learning systems, using them consistently, and becoming increasingly independent.



Systems We Use

You may work inside:

* ClickUp — tasks, ownership, deadlines, documentation, handoffs, and accountability

* GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, pipelines,
/SMS, follow-up, and automation

* Apollo — prospecting, contact research, and outbound outreach

* 
 — inbound lead opportunities

* Social media platforms

* Google Workspace

* Other marketing, outreach, reporting, and client-specific systems as needed

You are not required to already know every system.

However, you must be comfortable learning technology and consistently keeping systems updated.



Excellent English Is Required

A significant portion of our prospects and clients are based in the United States.

Because this position involves calling, following up with, and building relationships with U.S.-based prospects, excellent spoken English is essential.

You must be able to:

* Speak clearly and naturally

* Hold professional conversations with U.S.-based prospects

* Understand normal conversational English

* Communicate confidently over the phone

* Think and respond without relying entirely on a script

* Ask strong follow-up questions

* Build rapport

* Explain ideas clearly

* Handle objections professionally

* Write professional
s and messages

You do not need an American accent.

You do need to be easily understood and capable of building trust during a live sales conversation.



Voice Recording Required

Please submit a 60–90 second voice recording with your application.

In the recording:

1. Introduce yourself.

2. Briefly tell us about your sales, lead generation, or customer-facing experience.

3. Pretend you are calling a U.S. small-business owner who previously expressed interest in marketing help but never scheduled an appointment. Show us how you would open the conversation.

We are evaluating:

* English clarity

* Confidence

* Conversational ability

* Professionalism

* Ability to sound natural

* Phone presence

Do not submit an AI-generated or artificially altered voice.

We want to hear how you actually communicate.



What We May Sell

Depending on the opportunity, you may work with:

* Marketing Munster services

* Syndra CRM services

* Yelp advertising partnership opportunities

* Marketing retainers

* Websites

* SEO

* Paid advertising

* CRM and automation

* Branding

* Lead generation

* Digital marketing services

* Other approved products, services, or partnerships

You will not be expected to master everything immediately.

We will help you learn the offers.

We expect you to develop enough understanding to qualify needs, communicate value, identify opportunities, and know when additional support is needed.



Client Outreach

Conduct outreach on behalf of Marketing Munster clients.

This could include:

* B2B lead generation

* B2C outreach

* Appointment setting

* Partnership outreach

* Influencer outreach

* Referral campaigns

*
 campaigns

* Lead follow-up and reactivation

These responsibilities may vary depending on client needs.

However, Marketing Munster's sales pipeline remains your primary responsibility.



What We Are Looking For

We are open to both experienced salespeople and highly coachable candidates with strong potential.

We care about results, communication ability, initiative, and willingness to improve more than impressive job titles.

You should have:

* Strong spoken and written English

* Sales, appointment-setting, lead-generation, or business-development experience

* Confidence speaking with prospects

* Strong follow-up habits

* Willingness to conduct outbound prospecting

* Comfort with phone calls

* Ability to work independently

* Strong organization

* Curiosity

* Coachability

* Persistence

* Comfort receiving feedback

* Willingness to learn new systems

* Ability to identify what should happen next without always waiting for instructions



Strongly Preferred Experience

We are especially interested if you have experience with:

* GoHighLevel

* Apollo

*
 automations

* Cold

* CRM management

* Social media prospecting

* LinkedIn prospecting

* Partnership development

* Referral outreach

* Influencer outreach

* Agency sales

* Digital marketing services

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* B2B sales

* U.S.-based prospects or clients

You do not need every item on this list to apply.



This Probably Is NOT the Right Role for You If

This position is probably not a fit if you:

* Are looking for something where you can simply wait for tasks to be assigned

* Need constant reminders about what to do next

* Strongly dislike outbound outreach

* Do not like speaking on the phone

* Are unwilling to learn and grow

* Become defensive when receiving feedback

* Regularly leave CRM records incomplete

* Resist using systems or processes

* Expect leads to always be provided to you

* Are uncomfortable being accountable for results

* Finish a task list and stop working even when the pipeline needs attention

* Want to simultaneously work another job during your scheduled Marketing Munster hours

You may have outside employment or freelance work outside of your Marketing Munster schedule, but it cannot overlap with or interfere with your scheduled working hours, availability, responsiveness, confidentiality, or performance.



What Ownership Means Here

We are not expecting you to work unlimited hours.

We are expecting you to use your scheduled hours intelligently.

If you finish your assigned tasks but your appointment numbers are low, there are old leads that need follow-up, prospects that could be researched, partnerships that could be identified, or outreach that could be completed, we expect you to recognize that there is still productive sales work available.

We want someone who asks:

"What can I do next to create another opportunity?"

rather than:

"What task are you giving me next?"



What Marketing Munster Will Provide

Ownership goes both ways.

We understand that salespeople need structure, training, and feedback to succeed.

Marketing Munster will continue to provide and improve:

* Service and offer information

* Target customer information

* Sales messaging

* Scripts and talk tracks

* Lead sources

* CRM and pipeline structure

* Follow-up processes

* Pricing guidance

* Proposal processes

* Objection-handling guidance

* Systems training

* Sales coaching

* Performance expectations

* Feedback and development

Our sales system is continuing to evolve, and we want someone who is comfortable helping us improve it while they grow in the role.



First 90 Days



First 30 Days

You should:

* Learn our core services and offers

* Learn our target customers

* Become comfortable with our systems

* Understand our sales process

* Begin working leads

* Begin outbound prospecting

* Demonstrate strong phone communication

* Follow up consistently

* Keep CRM and ClickUp records accurate

* Demonstrate coachability and initiative



By 60 Days

You should:

* Manage your follow-up with less supervision

* Consistently generate sales conversations

* Book qualified appointments

* Build an active pipeline

* Work provided and self-generated opportunities

* Become more comfortable with discovery and sales conversations

* Identify social, referral, and partnership opportunities



By 90 Days

We want to see:

* Consistent qualified lead generation

* Consistent qualified appointments

* An actively managed pipeline

* Reliable follow-up

* Increasing independence

* Strong CRM discipline

* Evidence that your activity is creating real opportunities

* At least one closed new deal



Compensation

Hourly Base: $3–$5 USD per hour depending on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skills.

Commission: Additional commission will be paid on eligible in-house sales and revenue opportunities.

Strong candidates who demonstrate excellent English, real sales ability, independence, GHL/automation experience, and a history of producing results may be considered above the standard range.

We want compensation to reward people who help generate meaningful, profitable revenue.



Schedule

This position will begin at approximately 30 hours per week.

Hours may generally range between 20–40 hours per week depending on business needs, pipeline activity, campaigns, and performance.

You will have a fixed schedule aligned with California / Pacific Time business hours.

Because live calls and prospect communication are an important part of this position, reliable availability during your scheduled hours is required.



How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your Voice Recording

Submit the 60–90 second recording described above.

2. Your Sales Experience

Tell us about one product or service you personally sold.

Please explain:

* What you were selling

* Who you were selling to

* How the lead was found

* What you personally did

* What happened

3. Prospecting & Partnerships

Imagine Marketing Munster wants to find new referral or strategic partners.

Tell us two places you would personally look for potential partners and what you would do to start the conversation.

4. Systems Experience

Tell us what you have personally done inside GoHighLevel, Apollo, or another CRM/email outreach system.

Please be specific.

Simply saying "I have experience with GHL" is not enough.

5. Ownership Question

You have two hours remaining in your scheduled shift.

Nobody has assigned you another task, but your qualified appointments are below target.

What exactly do you do for those two hours?



We are not looking for the person with the fanciest resume.

We are looking for someone with excellent communication, initiative, persistence, curiosity, strong follow-up, willingness to learn, and the ability to help us create revenue.

title: Accountability Coach
description:
We run a program where people hire a "Boss" for their personal life.



Our members are building businesses, writing books, releasing music, getting fit. They already know what to do. They just don't do it, because nobody is expecting them to.



So we give them a Boss. You would be that Boss.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO

You'd look after a few small teams, about 4 to 12 people in total.



Every week, each person tells you three times for each day: what time they'll wake up, what time they'll start work, and what time they'll submit proof of what they got done.



Your job is to notice when they don't. There will be a specific platform the check-ins will happen on (it looks like a regular chat for messages).



If someone doesn't check in at 7:00, you message them at 7:05. If they don't reply, you call them at 7:10. Friendly and direct, no lecture. Something like: "morning, missed you at check-in. what's going on today?"



The rest of the time you keep the team chats alive. Cheering people on, responding to their messages, seeing how they are doing, asking how the thing they were stuck on is going.



Once a week you run 20-minute 1:1 meetings with each member of your team as a quick weekly touch base on their goals, and helping them plan their next week's worth of check-ins.



THE SCHEDULE

Depending on how many members are assigned to you, your work will fluctuate. Check-ins are as quick as responding to a message, with more time spent texting/calling them if they haven't shown up. As these times range throughout the day, most of the day will be flexible. Check-ins will go from Monday through Saturday, with no check-ins Sunday apart from the 1:1 meetings.



Hours are flexible and accommodating as you may give away check-ins that don't work with your schedule to others. Your pay is based purely on the number of members you chase and the number of 1:1 meetings you host.



Holding 9 members accountable is around $280 dollars a month.



Between those check-in times, your time is your own. Most people do this alongside other work, and that is completely fine. We encourage it.



We are hiring for two shifts:

- US time zone

- European/Asian time zone



If you do a good job, and never miss calling someone out when they don't check-in, this pay goes up with time... up to $400 to $500 if you prove to be very skilled.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Reliable. This is the whole job. If you say you will message someone at 7:05, you message them at 7:05.

- Organized. You will be tracking 12 people's schedules without dropping anyone.

- Warm and easy to talk to. People should be glad you messaged them.

- Excellent English, written and spoken. You will be on video every week. No accent at all.

- Reliable 24/7 access to internet, with a backup, and a plan for brownouts.

- A good camera and microphone.

- Comfortable sending text messages and making short phone calls.



Experience in customer support, online English teaching, client success, or community management is a big plus. Coaching experience is a plus too.





HOW TO APPLY

Send an
 to 
 with a video of yourself explaining why you're interested in the job, how you spend the rest of your time (what other obligations do you have), and why you'd be a good fit.

title: Packaging Engineer & Product Specs Controller
description:

We are a leader in the cosmetic industry, committed to innovation, efficiency, and excellence. With a focus on optimizing our products and packaging to exceed client expectations, we’re looking for a skilled individual to help us achieve our high standards.



Role Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Packaging Engineer & Product Specs Controller with strong mathematical and geometry skills to determine and design the best packaging solutions for our products. This role involves selecting and specifying the correct types of cartons and packaging from the unit carton to the pallet level, ensuring efficiency in weight, dimensions, safety, and cost. Additionally, this role will manage product specifications, including weights and dimensions, as well as oversee Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and pricing.



Key Responsibilities:

• Specify and estimate weights, dimensions, and materials to ensure packaging is efficient in terms of cost, weight, and protection

• Create and manage product specifications, including packaging dimensions and weights, to facilitate accurate data sharing and accessibility

• Oversee COGS and pricing management, ensuring all information is accurate and current

• Collaborate with internal teams to maintain and implement best practices in packaging efficiency, cost management, and material selection

• Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure packaging meets high standards



Qualifications:



• Someone with a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

• Strong mathematical and geometric skills, essential for precise calculations and efficient packaging designs

• Proficiency in creating clear diagrams and visual aids for product specifications



Application Instructions:

To apply, please submit a three-minute (or less) video on why you’re the best fit for this role. Use the subject “I’m your packaging expert” at the top of your cover letter and send it with your CV.

We look forward to seeing your creativity and attention to detail in action!

title: Performance Marketing Specialist — Meta, Google & E-commerce Growth
description:
SHYU socks is looking for a talented Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team and work closely with our Head of Marketing.



We're an e-commerce brand advertising primarily across Meta and Google, and we're looking for someone who can help us manage, optimise and grow our paid acquisition.



This is initially a part-time role of approximately 20-25 hours per week, with the opportunity for the role to grow as SHYU socks grows.



We're open to discussing how those hours are structured. What's most important to us is finding the right person who can take genuine ownership of performance.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident inside Meta and Google Ads, but also enjoys looking at the bigger picture.

We care about profitable growth, not simply what Ads Manager says our ROAS is.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Your main focus will be the day-to-day management and optimisation of our Meta and Google advertising.

You'll work closely with our Head of Marketing, with plenty of opportunity to share ideas and make recommendations.



Your responsibilities will include:

Managing and optimising Meta and Google Ads campaigns

Building, scheduling and launching new campaigns

Monitoring performance and budget pacing

Making ongoing campaign optimisations

Identifying campaigns that have the potential to scale

Recommending when budgets should be increased, decreased or reallocated

Analysing creative performance and identifying creative fatigue

Helping identify what types of creative we should test next

Monitoring Google search terms, keywords and campaign performance

Checking tracking, attribution and campaign setup

Producing clear weekly performance reports

Explaining what is changing, why you think it's happening and what you recommend doing next



As we build trust and you become familiar with the business, we'd like you to have increasing ownership and autonomy over our paid acquisition.



LOOKING BEYOND THE ADVERTISING PLATFORMS

One of the things that's important to us is understanding the whole e-commerce picture.

We're looking for someone who understands metrics such as:

MER

CAC / CPA

ROAS

AOV

Conversion Rate

LTV

Contribution Margin



You don't need to personally implement every change across the website, but we'd love you to identify opportunities and bring ideas to the team.



For example, you might notice an opportunity to:

Increase AOV through bundles or multi-buy offers

Test a different free-shipping threshold

Improve the conversion rate of a landing or product page

Send traffic towards a higher-performing product or offer

Improve first-order customer economics

Scale a campaign that's performing particularly well

Test a new audience, campaign structure or creative angle

Identify why performance has suddenly improved or declined



We want someone who's naturally curious about the numbers and enjoys asking:

"Why is this happening, and what could we test to improve it?"



WORKING WITH OUR HEAD OF MARKETING

You'll work directly with our Head of Marketing, who oversees the broader marketing strategy, creative direction and priorities.

However, we don't want you to feel that your job is simply to follow instructions.

We genuinely welcome ideas and recommendations.

If you think we should increase a campaign budget, we'd like you to tell us.

If you think an offer isn't working, tell us.

If you spot an opportunity to increase AOV or conversion rate, we'd love to hear it.

And if you disagree with something we're doing or think there's a better approach, we're happy for you to say so.

We're looking for someone who can become a trusted part of the marketing team and who enjoys contributing ideas as well as executing them.



ABOUT YOU

You'll ideally have:

Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads

Good hands-on experience with Google Ads

Experience working with e-commerce / DTC businesses

Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets

A good understanding of MER, CAC, ROAS, AOV and conversion rate

Strong analytical skills

An understanding of creative testing and creative fatigue

An understanding of e-commerce conversion optimisation

Confidence making recommendations based on data

Good attention to detail

Clear written and spoken English

A proactive and organised approach to your work

You don't need to know everything.

We're much more interested in someone who has strong fundamentals, is curious, asks good questions and wants to keep improving.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Over time, we'd like you to develop a strong understanding of SHYU socks, our products and our customers.

We want you to be able to look at our performance and confidently tell us things like:

"This campaign is performing well and I think we have room to increase the budget."

"CPA has increased over the last two weeks. I've looked into it and I think this is what's causing it."

"Our ads are performing well, but I think there's an opportunity to improve AOV by testing this offer."

The goal is for you to become someone our Head of Marketing can trust to help manage and grow our paid acquisition.



HOW TO APPLY

We'd love to learn a little about your experience and how you think.

When applying, please answer the five questions below in your own words. We're much more interested in your experience and approach than receiving a perfectly written application.

Tell us briefly about your experience managing Meta and Google Ads for e-commerce brands.

What approximate monthly advertising budgets have you personally managed?

Tell us about one campaign or account that you improved. What did you notice, what did you change, and what happened?

How do you think about metrics such as MER, CAC, AOV and conversion rate when d
 whether to scale advertising?

Tell us about an opportunity you've identified outside the advertising platform that helped improve performance - for example an offer, bundle, landing page, conversion rate or AOV improvement.

Please start your application with the word "SHYU" so we know you've read the full description.



ABOUT SHYU SOCKS

We're building SHYU socks for the long term and want people who enjoy being part of that journey.

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with our Head of Marketing, take increasing ownership of paid acquisition and have a genuine influence on how we grow.



If you're analytical, curious about e-commerce and genuinely enjoy performance marketing, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant
description:
# Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant



**Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity**



## Compensation & Schedule



* **Pay:** $3-$5 per hour based on experience 

* **Initial schedule:** 10–15 hours per week

* **Initial research period:** September–December 2026

* **Location:** Remote

* **Opportunity for continued long-term work based on performance**



## About the Company



We are a New Jersey-based professional pressure washing and exterior cleaning company that currently serves residential and commercial customers.



Our primary growth objective for 2027 is to significantly expand the **commercial side of our business** and develop long-term relationships with commercial properties and organizations.



We are building a dedicated commercial prospecting system consisting of:



**Research Department → CRM Database → Calling Department → Qualified Opportunities → Owner/Sales → Estimates & Contracts**



We are hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to handle the **research and database-building portion of this system.**



*VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WILL BE IN CHARGE OF BUILDING CRM SYSTEM FOR COMPANY*



This is NOT primarily a cold-calling position.



Your responsibility will be to identify high-quality potential commercial customers, research their contact information and decision-makers, and accurately enter and maintain this information in our CRM so our calling team can focus on making calls.



---



# Your Primary Objective



Your goal is to build/create and continuously maintain a large, accurate database of potential commercial customers for our exterior cleaning services.



Our calling department should be able to open the CRM, select the next prospect, and immediately have the information needed to make the call.



**We do not want our callers spending their paid calling time searching Google for phone numbers, websites, property managers, or company information.**



Your research makes their calling possible.





Our long-term goal is to transition the company toward a predominantly **commercial exterior-cleaning business**, while continuing to service residential customers.



Your research will directly contribute to achieving these goals.



---



# Commercial Prospects You Will Research



You will research commercial properties and organizations throughout our assigned New Jersey service territories, including but not limited to:



### Highest-Priority Prospects



* Condominium communities

* Homeowners Associations (HOAs)

* Apartment complexes

* Multifamily communities

* Property-management companies

* Commercial property-management companies

* Country clubs

* Golf courses

* Wedding venues

* Event venues



### Additional Commercial Prospects



* Hotels

* Resorts

* Senior-living communities

* Assisted-living facilities

* Shopping centers

* Strip malls

* Commercial plazas

* Office buildings

* Commercial campuses

* Restaurants

* Restaurant groups

* Franchise locations

* Swim clubs

* Community pools

* Private pools/facilities

* Schools

* Daycare facilities

* Churches and religious facilities

* Municipal buildings

* Municipal facilities

* Public facilities

* Warehouses

* Industrial properties

* Car dealerships

* Medical facilities

* Gyms and fitness centers

* Other commercial properties that could reasonably require professional exterior cleaning or pressure washing



You should also identify **companies that manage multiple properties**, as these may represent especially valuable opportunities.



---



# Information Required for EACH Prospect



Accuracy is extremely important.



Each qualified prospect should contain as much of the following information as reasonably available:



### Required Basic Information



1. Business/property name

2. Commercial category/property type

3. Full property address

4. City

5. County

6. Main business telephone number

7. Company/property website

8. General business
 address, when available

9. Google/business listing information when relevant



### Decision-Maker Information



Research the person most likely responsible for hiring exterior-maintenance contractors.



Potential titles include:



* Property Manager

* Community Manager

* Regional Property Manager

* Facilities Manager

* Facilities Director

* Maintenance Manager

* Maintenance Director

* General Manager

* Operations Manager

* Director of Operations

* Purchasing Manager

* Procurement Contact

* HOA/Condominium Association Manager

* Other relevant decision-maker



When publicly available, collect:



10. Decision-maker's full name

11. Job title

12. Business telephone number

13. Business/direct telephone number, if publicly available

14. Business
 address

15. LinkedIn/profile information when useful and publicly available



**Do not collect private or inappropriate personal information. We are looking for legitimate business contact information.**



### Property/Company Intelligence



When reasonably available, also research:



16. Property-management company

17. Parent company/ownership organization

18. Approximate property size

19. Approximate number of buildings

20. Approximate number of units for condos/apartments

21. Other properties managed by the same management company

22. Other locations owned/operated by the same organization

23. Relevant notes that could help our calling team



For example:



**ABC Condominium Association → managed by XYZ Property Management → XYZ manages 11 additional communities.**



That relationship is extremely valuable and should be documented.



---



# CRM Responsibilities



You will be responsible for accurately entering and maintaining all research inside our CRM/database.



Every record should be:



* Complete

* Properly categorized

* Properly formatted

* Free of obvious spelling errors

* Checked for duplicate entries

* Assigned to the correct geographic area

* Assigned to the correct commercial category

* Updated when better information becomes available



You may also receive records from our calling department marked **"Research Needed."**



For example, a caller may discover that a condominium is managed by a particular property-management company. Your responsibility may then be to research that management company, identify the appropriate contacts, determine what other properties it manages, and add those opportunities to the CRM.



You are expected to keep our commercial prospect database organized, useful, and continuously filled with new contacts (potential customers)



---



# Productivity Expectations



We care about **quality AND quantity**.



Entering hundreds of inaccurate names and phone numbers is not acceptable.



Spending an entire hour researching only a few basic business phone numbers is also not acceptable.





These numbers are performance targets, not permission to sacrifice accuracy.



Some high-value prospects may require additional research, particularly large condominium communities, apartment complexes, property-management companies, country clubs, and wedding venues.



**One thoroughly researched property-management company responsible for 20 properties can be more valuable than 20 poorly researched businesses.**



---



# Priority System



Prospects will generally be categorized by potential value.



### A — HIGH PRIORITY



Examples:



* Large condominium/HOA communities

* Large apartment complexes

* Property-management companies managing multiple properties

* Large country clubs

* Golf courses

* Large wedding/event venues

* Multi-location commercial organizations



### B — MEDIUM PRIORITY



Examples:



* Hotels

* Senior-living facilities

* Swim clubs

* Shopping centers

* Commercial buildings

* Schools

* Large churches

* Medium-sized commercial facilities



### C — STANDARD COMMERCIAL PROSPECTS



Examples:



* Individual restaurants

* Small commercial buildings

* Smaller businesses

* Other potential commercial exterior-cleaning customers



You should always prioritize **quality, high-value commercial opportunities** over simply generating the largest possible number of records.



---



# What Success Looks Like



When you are doing your job successfully, our cold-calling team should NEVER have to spend significant time searching for companies to call.



They should be able to:



**Open CRM → Review Prospect → Call → Record Outcome → Call Next Prospect**



Your responsibility is to keep that pipeline full.







---



# Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Reliable

* Efficient

* Comfortable performing extensive online research

* Experienced with CRM systems or willing to learn quickly

* Experienced with spreadsheets/databases

* Able to follow written instructions EXACTLY

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable researching businesses and commercial properties

* Able to verify information rather than guessing

* Strong written English skills

* Consistent with formatting and data entry

* Able to recognize duplicate information

* Able to understand company relationships and decision-maker roles

* Comfortable being measured against weekly productivity goals



Experience researching property managers, real estate companies, facilities managers, commercial businesses, or B2B prospects is a major plus.



---



# IMPORTANT — APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



**Attention to detail is extremely important for this position.**



We receive many applications. One of the first things we will evaluate is whether you carefully read this entire job posting and followed the instructions below.



To apply, please do ALL of the following:



### 1. Use this exact subject line:



**COMMERCIAL RESEARCH 2027**



### 2. Begin your application with this exact sentence:



**“I read the entire Commercial Research job description and understand that accuracy and attention to detail are essential.”**



### 3. Answer these five questions:



**A.** Tell us about your previous experience researching businesses, leads, properties, or decision-makers.



**B.** What tools or websites have you previously used to find business contact information?



**C.** What CRM systems have you previously used?



**D.** If you discovered that one property-management company manages 15 condominium communities, explain what you would do with that information.



**E.** In 2–3 sentences, explain what you believe the main purpose of this position is.



### 4. Final Attention-to-Detail Test



At the **very end of your application**, after answering all five questions, write:



**LWPWS*



Do not place these words anywhere else in your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly may not be considered.



---



# Final Note



This position is extremely important to the growth of our company.



We are not looking for someone to simply copy and paste business names.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a **high-quality commercial prospecting database** that our sales/calling department can continuously work from.



The information you gather will directly support our effort to acquire commercial pressure-washing and exterior-cleaning contracts throughout New Jersey.



If you are organized, efficient, reliable, excellent at online research, and take pride in accurate work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter – Business Funding | Base + Commission
description:
PillarStar Capital is a growing U.S. business-funding company looking for an experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter to join our team.



This is not an entry-level cold-calling position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), alternative business funding, and how to speak confidently with U.S. business owners.



Your primary goal is to turn leads into qualified merchants with completed applications and bank statements.



You will work leads provided by PillarStar and move merchants through:



Lead → Conversation → Interest → Qualification → Application/Bank Statements → Complete Package



Our processing and closing team will handle the later stages of the transaction.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners.

Speak with owners and decision makers.

Identify current or future business-funding needs.

Determine requested funding amount and use of funds.

Ask about monthly business revenue.

Identify existing MCA positions and payments.

Qualify merchants according to PillarStar guidelines.

Request applications and recent business bank statements.

Handle common merchant objections professionally.

Follow up aggressively but professionally with interested merchants.

Re-engage previous leads.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up dates.

Work closely with processing and closing staff.

Help consistently generate complete funding packages, not just calls.

Who We Are Looking For



2+ years of direct MCA/business-funding experience is strongly preferred.



You should already understand terms such as:



First position

Second position

Stacking

Daily/weekly payments

Bank statements

Revenue qualification

Funding applications



You should also have:



Strong spoken English.

Clear, confident phone presence.

Experience calling U.S. business owners.

Strong objection-handling skills.

Experience asking merchants for applications and bank statements.

CRM and outbound-dialer experience.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Backup internet/power.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation



Starting rate: $4.00/hour



Strong candidates with verifiable MCA experience may start higher, up to $5.00/hour.



There will be a 30-day performance review, with opportunities for increases based on results.



You will also earn:



5% of PillarStar Capital's commission actually collected on funded transactions originating from your assigned leads.



Commission is earned only after the transaction funds and PillarStar receives its commission.



As the company grows, strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, bonuses, senior sales responsibilities, and advancement into closing roles.



How Performance Is Measured



We care about results, not meaningless dialing.



We measure:



Calls → Merchant Conversations → Interested Merchants → Applications/Statements Requested → Complete Packages → Funded Deals



We also measure call quality, attendance, follow-up, CRM accuracy, professionalism, and package quality.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PILLARSTAR MCA – [Your Name] – [Years of MCA Experience]



Please submit:



1. Your resume



2. A REQUIRED 60–90 second voice sample



In your normal speaking voice:



Introduce yourself.

Tell us how many years of MCA/business-funding experience you have.

Give us a 20–30 second example of how you would open a call with a U.S. business owner.

Then answer this merchant objection:



“I'm not sending you my bank statements until you tell me what rate you're offering.”



Do not submit an AI-generated voice.



Answer These 7 Questions

How many years have you worked specifically in MCA or alternative business funding? What were your roles?

In your most recent MCA role, approximately how many complete applications + bank-statement packages did you personally generate per week?

Approximately how many funded transactions per month originated from your opportunities, if your company tracked this?

Explain the difference between a first-position MCA, second-position MCA, and stacking.

Write exactly what you would say if a merchant tells you:

“I'm not sending statements until you tell me the rate.”

Which MCA CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms have you previously used?

What hourly rate are you currently seeking, and are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours?



Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and live MCA merchant role-play.

This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Physician Business Development Liaison
description:
Are you a Philippines-based Physician (MD) with a sharp commercial mindset, a passion for health tech, and a knack for building high-level relationships?



At Contact Marketers LLC , we apply a unique, highly successful liaison model—placing industry experts at the forefront of our business development efforts. Following the success of our Attorney Liaison role, we are expanding this model into the healthcare sector.



We are seeking a Physician Business Development Liaison to serve as our peer-level ambassador to the medical world. In this high-impact role, you won't be practicing clinically or making cold sales pitches; instead, you will use your medical credibility, local network, and industry insights to initiate meaningful partnerships with hospital leaders, imaging center owners, and healthcare executives across the Philippines, Asia, and the United States.



From day one, you will help unlock strategic opportunities in cutting-edge spaces like radiology AI adoption, health data informatics, and hospital referral networks—starting with key global partnerships like California-based Vega Imaging Informatics.



What You'll Do

Build Strategic Pipeline: Identify, target, and connect with radiology directors, hospital administrators, and healthcare executives across the Philippines, the wider APAC region, and the US



Bridge Clinical & Commercial Discussions: Initiate peer-to-peer conversations with healthcare decision-makers, presenting high-value partnership opportunities with physician-level credibility.



Facilitate High-Value Introductions: Warm-introduce qualified healthcare prospects into the Contact Marketers referral and partner pipeline.



Represent at Industry Events: Attend virtual meetings and global industry conferences (eg, RSNA, SIIM) to represent the brand and expand our medical network.



Manage & Track Relationships: Document outreach and pipeline progress, collaborating directly with executive leadership.



What We Are Looking For

Medical Credentials: Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree from a recognized Philippine medical school. Valid PRC license is a plus (clinical practice is not required).



Radiology / Imaging Knowledge: Strong familiarity with the Philippine radiology landscape, hospital imaging departments, or imaging informatics. Affiliations with bodies like the Philippine College of Radiology or PMA are highly valued.



Business Acumen: A natural commercial instinct with prior experience in medical device, diagnostics, pharma, or healthtech sales/partnerships.



US Outreach Readiness: Excellent written and spoken English fluency, with the confidence to conduct outreach and lead meetings with US hospital executives.



Data Privacy Awareness: Working knowledge of health data privacy concepts (HIPAA in the US and the Philippine Data Privacy Act).



Time Flexibility: Ability to work standard Philippine hours, with periodic availability during US business hours for conference calls and outreach.



Nice-to-Haves

Prior exposure to radiology AI, teleradiology, or health data de-identification models.



Pre-existing contacts among hospital administrators or radiology department heads in the Philippines.



Previous experience in international business development or remote US healthcare partnerships.



Why Join Contact Marketers?

High-Impact Role: Move beyond routine clinical work and operate at the intersection of medicine, healthtech, and global business.



Peer-Level Influence: Represent our brand with fellow healthcare leaders as a trusted medical colleague, not a conventional sales rep.



Immediate Strategic Focus: Tackle high-priority global projects from day one with direct reporting to leadership.
