title: Operations & Client Services Specialist
description:
Operations & Client Services Specialist — Long-Term Position



Company: The Nonprofit Launcher



Starting Pay: $6 USD/hour



Hours: 40 hours per week



Location: Remote



Position: Long-Term



About The Nonprofit Launcher

The Nonprofit Launcher is a U.S.-based company that helps entrepreneurs, community leaders, and nonprofit founders successfully launch and build nonprofit organizations.

We assist clients with nonprofit formation, organizational documents, 501(c)(3) applications, marketing strategies, websites, and other services needed to successfully launch their organizations.



We are growing and are looking for a highly organized Operations & Client Services Specialist to become a long-term member of our team.



About the Position



This is not a basic data-entry Virtual Assistant position.



You will be trained to help manage the day-to-day client fulfillment process for our company.

You will work directly with our internal systems,
, Google Workspace, ChatGPT/AI tools, client onboarding information, documents, and established company procedures.

You do NOT need to already know how to complete every nonprofit filing or use every system we use.

We will train you.

What matters most is that you are intelligent, highly organized, dependable, comfortable learning new technology, able to follow detailed processes, and willing to take ownership of your responsibilities.



Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will eventually include:

Managing and responding to routine client
s

Reviewing client onboarding forms

Identifying missing client information

Organizing client files and documents

Using ChatGPT and company-approved AI prompts

Creating mission, vision, and purpose statement drafts

Producing client documents using established company templates and AI workflows

Preparing bylaws, policies, procedures, and other organizational documents

Creating marketing plans using our established process

Reviewing AI-generated work for accuracy before delivery

Preparing information needed for state nonprofit filings

Assisting with permitted state filing processes

Preparing information for EIN applications

Preparing 501(c)(3) applications using our established processes and templates

Monitoring client projects for state approvals and other updates

Downloading and properly organizing approval documents

Sending clients milestone updates

Maintaining accurate client project statuses

Coordinating with our Website Designer when a client's package includes a website

Following up with clients when information is missing

Making sure client projects continue moving forward

Escalating unusual or sensitive situations to management

You will receive training on our specific processes.

AI & ChatGPT

AI is an important part of how our company operates.

You should be comfortable learning how to use ChatGPT and other AI-powered systems.

We already have established prompts and processes for many of the documents we create.

You will NOT be expected to invent everything yourself.

You will be trained to use our systems correctly, review AI-generated work, make necessary corrections, and ensure the final work meets our standards.

Previous experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools is strongly preferred.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Reliable

Comfortable communicating professionally with U.S. clients

Strong in written English

Comfortable learning new software

Comfortable using AI

Able to follow detailed instructions

Able to learn repeatable processes

Able to manage multiple clients simultaneously

Able to identify when something is missing or incorrect

Able to work independently

Comfortable taking ownership of assigned responsibilities

Interested in a long-term position

Comfortable handling confidential client information responsibly

Experience with customer service, administrative operations, Google Workspace, ChatGPT, document preparation, government forms, legal/administrative documents, or professional services is a plus.

Nonprofit experience is NOT required.



Compensation & Benefits

Starting Pay: $6 USD/hour

Hours: 40 hours per week



After 90 days:

Formal performance review

Opportunity for a $0.50/hour raise based on performance

10 paid PTO days per year



Additional benefits include:

13th-month annual pay/benefit

Opportunity to earn up to a $100 USD monthly performance bonus

Long-term employment opportunity

Opportunity to take on increased responsibility as the company grows



Growth Opportunity

We are not looking for someone to simply complete random tasks.

Our goal is to find someone who can learn our entire client fulfillment process and eventually take significant ownership of our day-to-day operations.



As you become more experienced, you will be expected to require less supervision, solve routine problems independently, and help ensure that client projects are completed accurately and on time.



There is significant opportunity to grow within this role as our company continues to expand.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



Tell us about your previous administrative, operations, or client-service experience.

How would you rate your written English from 1–10? Explain your rating.

How experienced are you with ChatGPT or other AI tools? Tell us specifically how you have used them.

How experienced are you with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gmail?

Have you ever worked with government applications, legal documents, administrative forms, or other detail-sensitive paperwork? Please explain.

Imagine you are managing 6 client projects simultaneously. How would you make sure nothing is forgotten?

If a client
s you asking a question and you do not know the answer, what would you do?

If ChatGPT creates a document for a client, would you send it immediately or review it first? 

Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?

Are you available to work 40 hours per week?

What hours do you normally work in Philippine Time?

What is your desired hourly rate?

Why are you interested in a long-term position with The Nonprofit Launcher?





At the very bottom of your application, write the exact words:



DETAILS MATTER



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Etsy Shop Manager & E-Commerce Growth Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Etsy Shop Manager & E-Commerce Growth Specialist to take ownership of growing Etsy as a sales channel for two U.S.-based brands.



This is NOT a data-entry position. We do not need someone whose job is simply to upload products we give them.

We want someone who can look at our business and the information we provide, understand our customers and products, research the Etsy marketplace, determine what has the best opportunity to sell, launch those products, and continuously improve performance.



You will be responsible for the Etsy channel from research and strategy through listing creation and management, including:

Audit existing Etsy shops and listings

Research competitors and successful products

Perform Etsy keyword and search research

Identify product opportunities

Recommend which existing products should be sold on Etsy

Recommend new products that could be developed from existing content or assets

Create high-quality listings with effective titles, descriptions, tags, and categories

Recommend pricing, bundles, gifts, seasonal products, and promotions

Manage customer questions and routine Etsy customer service

Monitor Etsy analytics and Track traffic, favorites, conversions, sales

Plan for seasonal and holiday opportunities

Provide regular reports explaining what happened, what you learned, and what you recommend doing next



About the Brands

One brand centers around tea, tea parties, gifts, specialty teas, tea experiences, subscription products, games, educational content, and other tea-related products.



The second brand, A Glitch Effect, has a separate collection of products like shirts and PDF guides. You will have the opportunity to evaluate both brands for Etsy opportunities.



Your job is to help determine which ideas have the best opportunity to make money.

The business will Provide product and brand information and Fulfill and ship physical orders.

We want the Etsy manager to handle as much of the rest of the Etsy operation as possible.



You Should Be Comfortable Working Independently

You should be able to say:

“I researched this market. Here is what customers are searching for. Here are the competitors. Here are the products I recommend testing. Here is why. Here is what I need from the creative team. Here is how I will measure whether it worked.”



We value people who bring solutions and recommendations, not only questions and tasks.



Required Skills

Proven Etsy shop management/growth experience

Etsy SEO, product and competitor research

Listing conversion and ecommerce analytics

Strong written English/customer communication

Independent problem-solving and ownership mentality



Helpful Skills

eRank, EverBee, Marmalead, EtsyHunt, Google Trends, Canva, etc.

Both physical and digital product experience



How to Apply

Please answer ALL of these questions:

What Etsy shop did you personally manage or help grow? 

What was your role, what did you change, and what measurable results occurred?

What are the first things you examine when an Etsy listing gets traffic but does not sell?

Which Etsy research/analytics tools do you use?

Start your application with “ETSY GROWTH” so we know you read the complete job description.



We expect this to begin as a part-time position.

There is an opportunity for this to become a long-term role and potentially expand into broader ecommerce management if the relationship and results are strong.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow this revenue area, not simply complete Etsy tasks.

title: AU Senior Accountant / Team Leader
description:
About Us



From SMEs and start-ups to large corporates, high-net-worth individuals, and self-managed super funds, our team has the depth and flexibility to meet diverse needs. We work alongside a strong network of legal, finance, and banking partners to ensure you're supported at every stage of your journey.



Job Summary



The Senior Accountant works independently to complete standard accounting and tax engagements with minimal supervision, while also providing support to other tea
mbers. The candidate manages their own workload; self-reviews output for quality and communicates proactively with the onshore team.



Why Join Us



Salary from PHP110,000 to 190,000 per month (depending on experience)

Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth

Supportive and collaborative work environment

Access to ongoing training

Friendly working environment

Permanent work-from-home set-up

New equipment supplied



The Role



We're growing, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Accountant with a strong grasp of Australian taxation to join our team.



If you know Australian tax inside out and take pride in accuracy, this role was made for you.



Roles and Responsibilities



Independently process electronic data and journal entries across all client sizes; prepare complete working papers and reconciliations with no guidance required.

Prepare and review financial statements, tax returns, BAS, FBT, and tax planning

Review returns for individuals, partnerships, trusts and companies

Ensure all client work is accurate, compliant, and meets Australian tax law requirements

Respond to client queries via
 or client portal under production manager oversight. Draft responses for production manager review on more complex matters.

Manage ATO client correspondence and queries

Attend to routine corporate secretarial requirements independently, including review of ASIC notifications, minutes, and resolutions.

Conduct tax research, stay updated on legislation, and anticipate changes

Prepare tax planning schedules and supporting analysis for manager/partner review



Why this role is for you



If you are an outgoing, confident communicator, love numbers, and are proactive, this role is perfect for you!



You have



At least 4 years of experience in Australian public practice accounting, with a focus on tax and financial statement preparation.

title: Order Processor & Pricing Assistant, VA Night Shift $4-$5 w/ Benefits
description:
Order Processor / Pricing Assistant



PLEASE READ THE WHOLE POST OR YOUR RESUME WILL BE IGNORED!



Location: Remote 

Days: Tuesday - Saturday

Job Type: Full-time, Night Shift (US West Coast hours)

Salary: $4-$5 an hour depending on experience

Benefits: 15 Days PTO, health insurance and 13th month salary



About Us

Hong Kong Market is a Las Vegas-based wholesale food distributor. We supply 200+ restaurants and most of the major casino resorts on the Strip. We prioritize people, strive to do the right thing, believe in the power of teamwork, foster a culture of greatness, and embrace the mindset that we're never done improving.



Job Description

You start as an ORDER PROCESSOR. Our restaurant and casino customers send in orders by
, text and spreadsheet all night. You enter them accurately, match what they asked for to the right item codes, and get them into QuickBooks so the warehouse can pick them in the morning. This is the part of the job you will do from day one, and it is where you learn our products, our customers and our system.



As you learn the catalog, you grow into the PRICING side. Every week and every month the casinos we supply send us bid sheets — long spreadsheets of item codes where we quote the price we will hold for them. You will help prepare those: checking our cost and margin on every line and flagging the items that need a price change. We will train you, and we want someone who wants to grow into it.



Either way, this is a numbers job. You will be in Excel and Google Sheets, and you need to be the kind of person who notices when a number looks wrong.



Key Responsibilities

From day one — order processing:

Enter customer orders accurately into QuickBooks from
, text and spreadsheets

Match what the customer wrote to the correct item code, unit and quantity

Check orders for missing, unclear or unusual lines and ask before guessing

Keep the order inbox clean so nothing sits unprocessed 

Pull and clean pricing, purchase history and inventory reports out of QuickBooks and Excel



At the same time — bid and pricing support:

Help prepare weekly and monthly casino bid sheets on deadline

Compare our cost vs. bid price on every line and be aware of margin

Flag items where cost has moved and a price change is needed; follow our written pricing rules on when to raise, lower, or hold

Match customer item codes to our internal item codes and keep the crosswalk files updated

Check incoming purchase orders against the active bid price and flag mismatches

Keep the bid tracker current so we always know what is due, submitted and won

Communicate clearly in writing with our purchasing and sales team





Qualifications

1+ year in order processing, purchasing, inventory, costing, bookkeeping or a similar numbers-driven role

Fast and accurate data entry — you will be entering real orders that ship the next morning

Strong Excel / Google Sheets — comfortable with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, filters and formulas. 

Experience with QuickBooks (or a similar accounting/inventory system) is a strong plus

Comfortable with cost, price, margin and comfortable converting different units-of-measurement

Familiar with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude / Claude Code, and able to use them to speed up spreadsheet work, clean up data and draft
s

Good written English

Reliable internet, minimum 25 Mbps

PC: 8GB RAM, dual core 2GHz or higher





Who We’re Looking For

Extremely detail-oriented — a wrong price on a bid sheet costs us real money

Self-starter who can own a recurring deadline without being reminded

Asks when something doesn't look right instead of guessing

Available during US West Coast business hours (graveyard shift in PH)

Positive attitude, coachable, flexible

Team player who is willing to grow and learn





Our Core Values

People First: We prioritize the well-being and development of our employees and clients.

Do the Right Thing: We act with integrity and honesty.

Together We Can: We believe in teamwork and collaboration.

Culture of Greatness: We strive for excellence in everything we do.

We're Never Done: We continuously seek to improve and innovate.





How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a short cover letter introducing yourself and why you think you’d be a good fit for the role. In your cover letter, please let us know your favorite fruit. If you pass our initial screening, we will send you a follow up questionnaire and test for the role. Please attach a copy of your resume. We will not respond to any
s. Only applications through onlinejobs.ph will be considered. 



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: REAL ESTATE APPOINTMENT SETTER (ISA) — BC MARKET
description:
THIS WILL BECOME A FULL-TIME JOB FOR THE RIGHT CANDIDATE.



About the role:



I am looking for a confident, experienced appointment setter to work with a real estate team operating in British Columbia, Canada. You will be calling leads, qualifying them, and booking appointments. This is a calling-heavy role. If you are not comfortable making a high volume of calls daily and handling objections naturally, this is not the right fit.



If you can build rapport fast, keep people on the phone, and turn a cold lead into a booked appointment, keep reading.



Starts at 20 hours a week with potential to grow to full-time.

Make outbound calls to warm and cold leads daily

Qualify prospects based on buying, selling, or investing intent

Book appointments directly into the agent's calendar

Log every call, outcome, and next step into GoHighLevel after each interaction

ISA training or formal appointment setting experience is a strong plus but not required. What matters is that you are comfortable qualifying leads and moving conversations toward a booked appointment.

s.

Write the word "DIALER" at the top of your message.

title: Inside Sales Rep — Residential Cleaning
description:
Inside Sales Rep — Residential Cleaning (Remote, Philippines-Based)



Inbound Leads Only. No Cold Calling. No Prospecting.



About the Role

5 Star Home Cleaning sells residential cleaning services across three U.S. markets — Arizona, Montana, and California. We're hiring an Inside Sales Rep to close warm, inbound leads: people who already filled out a form asking for a quote.

You'll talk to homeowners who already raised their hand, walk them through their home over the phone, build the right cleaning package, and collect payment — all in about 20 minutes per call.

This is a full-time, remote position for candidates based in the Philippines.



What You'll Do

Take inbound calls from leads who requested a quote

Build relationships with prospects and develop the sale

Ask the right questions following a script to understand the home — square footage, layout, condition, frequency needed

Recommend the right service and package based on what you hear

Build and present the deal clearly and confidently

Handle objections and close on the call — not "I'll follow up"

Collect payment or prepay before the call ends

Log every call and deal accurately in our CRM (GoHighLevel)



What Success Looks Like

We don't pay you to book jobs. We pay you to close jobs that pay us.

Commission is paid on cash collected, not on the sale being booked

A deep clean that gets scheduled but never gets paid earns $0 in commission

This means your job isn't just to get a "yes" — it's to get a "yes, and here's my card"

If you're the kind of rep who's comfortable asking for the sale and asking for the payment in the same breath, this structure will work in your favor. If you're used to soft closes and "I'll circle back," this isn't the right seat.



Pay Structure

Three tiers: Junior → Regular → Senior

You move up a tier by hitting cash-collected targets for three consecutive months

Every tier up increases your base pay and your commission percentage

There's no ceiling on Senior — you keep earning Senior-level pay for as long as you keep performing at that level

Base pay plus uncapped commission on cash collected (not on bookings)

Junior estimate monthly pay $1,000-$1,500

Regular estimate monthly pay $1,500-$2,000

Senior estimate monthly pay $2,000-$2,660+These are examples only — hit higher numbers, earn more. There's no cap on commission at any tier.



What We're Looking For

Strong spoken English, confident and warm on the phone

Sales experience preferred — inside sales, appointment closing, or similar phone-based closing roles

Comfortable asking directly for payment, not just for agreement

Organized — able to manage a pipeline of leads and follow-ups without things falling through the cracks

Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls during U.S. business hours (Mountain/Pacific time overlap)

Coachable — willing to run scripts, get feedback on calls, and improve week to week



What We Offer

100% inbound leads 

Clear, uncapped earning potential tied directly to your performance

A defined path from Junior to Senior with real income growth at each step

Ongoing training and call coaching to help you close more and earn more

A stable, established U.S. company across three markets

TikTok Live Scout — Virtual Assistant

Type: Remote / Contract (Overseas VA) Compensation: $10/hr Hours: Flexible

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to scout and identify TikTok LIVE creators who match our target profile for onboarding onto our platform. You'll spend your time inside the TikTok app searching, watching, and evaluating live streamers against a clear set of criteria — then logging qualified prospects for our team to review.

This is a research and identification role only — no outreach or DMing required. Strong candidates are people who already understand TikTok LIVE culture — gifting, leagues, community counts — and can quickly judge whether a streamer is a good fit.

What You'll Do

Search TikTok LIVE using target keywords (see below) to discover active streamers

Evaluate each streamer against our creator criteria

Check concurrent viewer count (CCV) and community/follower count by tapping into their live profile

Identify the streamer's league (C1–A2 range preferred)

Confirm the creator has an identifiable Instagram — either linked in their TikTok profile or clearly matchable by searching their TikTok handle on Instagram

Log qualified prospects in a shared tracking sheet (handle, CCV, community count, league, niche, Instagram link, notes)

Creator Criteria (What You're Looking For)

CCV: 100–500 concurrent viewers on TikTok, with a community count above 100. (Streamers below this range typically can't bring enough supporters over to make the move worthwhile.)

League: Generally between C1 and A2 (soft guideline, not a hard cutoff)

Instagram: Must have an identifiable Instagram account

Content style: Streams that go beyond just chatting or battling on screen — e.g. DJ sets, singing/guitar, speed dating, prank calls, tarot readings, talent shows, beauty boxes, game shows, talk shows

Format: Streamers using a "box" format (multi-guest layout) are prioritized over solo on-screen streamers

Search Keywords to Use

Music, singing, dating, dating show, box battles, talent, talent show, DJ, game show, gaming, beauty (excluding TikTok Shop creators), make me laugh, trolling, omegle

Requirements

Active, personal familiarity with TikTok and TikTok LIVE (gifting, leagues, community features)

Strong written English for clear, organized reporting

Reliable internet connection; hours are flexible

Comfortable using spreadsheets (Google Sheets) for daily tracking

Prior experience in social media talent scouting, community management, or influencer outreach a plus

How to Apply

Please include:

A short note on your experience with TikTok LIVE (as a viewer, gifter, or scout)

Your available hours and time zone

description:
Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant (Part-Time, Work From Home)



Real Deal Entertainment



Real Deal Entertainment, a Childrens Entertainment company specialising in Christmas, Easter and Halloween entertainment in Australia is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to join our team part-time. You'll handle follow ups from inbound enquiries, convert quotes into sales, upsell premium add-ons, and generate new business through outbound prospecting — all from the comfort of your home, with a pay structure that rewards initiative from Day 1.



What You'll Do:

- Inbound Sales Support: Respond to inbound enquiries and quote requests, follow up promptly, and convert bookings.

- Prop & Add-On Upselling: Identify and offer relevant prop/add-on upgrades on inbound bookings to enhance the client experience and booking value.

- Outbound Prospecting: Generate, qualify, and follow up on cold leads and independent network accounts to build new business.

- CRM & Administration: Maintain accurate records, call/meeting notes, and pipeline stages in the CRM.

- Client Communication: Deliver professional, prompt phone and
 communication with prospective and existing clients.



What We're Looking For

- Confident, clear English communicator with a friendly, consultative sales style. If you have expereince working with Australian clients this is a big bonus (as we speak a little differently here)

- Comfortable making and taking calls with Australian clients, and confident handling objections and pricing pushback.

A reliable, quiet home workspace with stable internet and a backup plan for outages.

- Strong organisational skills — able to juggle inbound enquiries, follow-ups, and CRM updates without dropping the ball.

- Prior sales, business development, account management, or telemarketing experience is ESSENTIAL.  We are looking for a highly talented and successful person who understands the psychology of sales and can also believe in our product.



Hours & Schedule

- Capacity: Part-Time, approximately 20-30 hours per week, increasing to 30 hours per week from September through Christmas.

- Hours: You will be working during AEST business hours (late morning and/or afternoon AEST).   If your daily or weekly schedule involves working on US or EU timezones this will not work.  In fact if you have another job that is 20 hrs or more, this will not work.  We need someone to be completely focused and prioritise this role, especially during the busy season. 

Work from home with a quiet, professional, distraction-free space for sales calls and meetings.



Pay & Incentives

- Base Pay

AU$9.00 per hour, for actual hours worked (20-30 hrs/week; 30 hrs/week from September through Christmas).

- Guaranteed from Day 1 — this is not a draw against commissions; you keep 100% of your base pay plus all incentives earned.

- Incentives (Commission)

Inbound Prop Upsells: 2.5% flat commission from Day 1, applied strictly to the gross dollar value of the props added to an initial inbound quote or booking with your influence.

Self-Generated / Cold Sales: 2.5% flat commission from Day 1 on all entirely cold leads or independent network accounts.

- Closing from Standard Inbound call follow ups: 0% commission. 



What You'll Need

- Equipment: You will need your own reliable computer/laptop, high quality noise-cancelling headset (as well as a quiet room without interruptions), and stable internet connection and electricity. Access to our phone/dialer and CRM systems will be provided.

- Mindset: A positive attitude, winning mindset and string work ethic



How to Apply

Interested? Send your application through onlinejobs.ph, including a recorded video intro telling us about your sales experience and your available hours, an updated resume, and a screenshot of your current internet speed test. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a short interview and role-play assessment.  Note, your ability to communicate clearly to our clients is paramount, so your video intro and your video interview will be testing your equipment quality as well as your spoken english fluency.

title: YouTube Automation Specialist / Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an experienced YouTube Automation Specialist / Video Editor who understands how to turn scripts, raw footage, clips, screenshots, and research into engaging YouTube videos that keep viewers watching.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already has experience editing professional YouTube content and understands that great YouTube editing is about more than cutting clips together.



You should understand storytelling, pacing, audience retention, motion graphics, thumbnails, titles, and YouTube SEO.



The Role



Your main responsibility will be taking a story or script and figuring out what the viewer should be seeing throughout the video.



You may receive a script along with clips, streams, social media posts, screenshots, articles, and other source material. You should be able to independently piece those materials together into a cohesive visual story without needing every edit explained to you.



You will be responsible for:



Editing long-form YouTube videos



Finding and selecting the best clips and visual moments



Structuring footage around the story being told



Creating strong hooks and maintaining viewer interest



Using B-roll, screenshots, social posts, images, captions, music, and sound effects effectively



Creating motion graphics and animated visual elements



Using animated text, callouts, timelines, maps, charts, overlays, tracking, masking, and other graphics when appropriate



Recognizing slow or unnecessary sections that could hurt retention



Using pattern interrupts without making videos feel over-edited



Helping develop high-CTR thumbnails



Developing compelling YouTube titles



Understanding YouTube SEO and discovery



Making revisions based on feedback and video performance





What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate understands the difference between simply editing a video and building a visual story for YouTube.



You should understand concepts such as:



Audience retention



Hooks and introductions



Story structure



Pacing



Curiosity and open loops



Pattern interrupts



Clip and B-roll selection



Motion graphics



Thumbnail psychology



Click-through rate



YouTube titles



YouTube SEO



Average view duration and retention analytics





When there isn't an obvious clip available for part of the script, you should be capable of figuring out how to visually communicate that information through graphics, screenshots, animation, B-roll, or other creative techniques.



Motion Graphics



Motion graphics experience is required.



We want someone who can go beyond basic cuts, transitions, and captions.



Experience creating elements such as animated typography, social media animations, callouts, timelines, maps, charts, tracked graphics, screen replacements, overlays, and custom visual sequences is valuable.



Experience with Adobe After Effects or comparable motion graphics software is strongly preferred.



Graphics should serve the story and help maintain attention—not simply be added for decoration.



Requirements



Previous professional YouTube editing experience



Strong portfolio of previous YouTube work



Long-form YouTube editing experience



Motion graphics experience



Strong English comprehension



Excellent visual storytelling skills



Strong understanding of pacing and retention



Ability to work independently



Ability to take a script and determine the appropriate visuals



Reliable communication



Ability to consistently meet deadlines



Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions



Experience with professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent





Experience working with YouTube automation, documentary, commentary, creator/internet news, entertainment, or similar channels is a major advantage.



Schedule & Turnaround



Hours are flexible.



We care more about the quality of your work and your ability to deliver projects quickly than what hours you choose to work.



However, quick turnaround is extremely important. Some of our content is based on timely or trending stories, so videos may need to be completed quickly.



You should be comfortable receiving a project and getting started without extensive supervision.



Who We're Looking For



We are not looking for an editor who needs to be told:



"Put this clip here, add this graphic here, and make this cut here."



We are looking for someone who naturally thinks:



"What should the viewer be seeing right now, and what will keep them interested in what happens next?"



The ideal candidate combines the skills of a video editor, visual storyteller, motion graphics designer, and YouTube strategist.



This can become a consistent, long-term position for the right person.



Payment



Payment is made once per month via Wise (formerly TransferWise).



Applicants must be able to receive payments through Wise. Payment terms and the agreed rate will be discussed before starting the position.



This is intended to be a consistent, long-term role for the right person.



A small trial video will be required unless profolio shows outstanding work and track record. 



How to Apply



Complete our short application below.



Your portfolio and previous YouTube work are extremely important and will be one of the primary things we use to evaluate candidates.



Previous experience is required. Please do not apply if you do not have previous work to show.



Apply for the YouTube Automation Specialist Position 



After submitting the application, you will be given the opportunity to schedule a short interview.

description:
About us



We are the Jim Black Group, a residential real estate team in Auburn, Massachusetts, brokered by Real Broker LLC. We have ten agents and we close roughly 200 transactions a year. Our promise to clients is that we will never sacrifice a relationship for a commission, and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally: we are clear about expectations, we train people properly, and we treat our team well.



The role



You will be the backend of our operations — the second set of hands behind our Transaction Coordinator and our Listing Coordinator, and the sole owner of our CRM. Two mornings a week are blocked on your calendar for database work and nothing else, because we take that half of the job seriously enough to protect it.



Your daily responsibilities would include:



Send a short end-of-day report by
 listing what you completed and what is still in progress.

Support our Transaction Coordinator on active files: collecting documents, tracking timelines, following up with lenders, title, and inspectors.

Support our Listing Coordinator on new listings: MLS input, coordinating photographers and vendors, keeping listing status current across platforms.

Own our CRM (Sierra Interactive): source-code every new contact within 48 hours, run a monthly audit for duplicates and incomplete records, and send us a monthly database health report.

Keep our referral platforms current — HomeLight and others: profile and transaction history updated, stage updates entered on every active referral, and a weekly report to us on any referral that has not been worked.



To qualify for the position, you will need at least 2 years of experience in the following:



Real estate CRM management — Sierra Interactive, Follow Up Boss, BoomTown, or kvCORE. You have owned a CRM, not just entered data into one.

U.S. real estate transaction coordination, contract to close. You already know what a contingency deadline is and why a missed one matters.

MLS and listing management.



Our team moves fast and our standards are high. It matters to us that you are:



Able to switch between urgent support work and focused solo project work in the same day without losing either

The kind of person errors bother personally — you double-check because you want it right, not because someone is watching

A proactive communicator who sends the update before it is asked for

Willing to follow a process exactly, and to speak up when the process itself is wrong



In addition to excellent written English, you will need to be at least familiar with:



Google Workspace — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets

Microsoft Excel

Slack

Zoom and Google Meet

Web research



Not required, but it helps if you have:



Direct Sierra Interactive experience

Sisu

DotLoop



Work schedule and holidays



This is a full-time position, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week

At least six of those hours must overlap 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern time (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila time). The rest of your hours are flexible.

You will qualify for 5 vacation days and 5 sick days after the 6-month probation period

We honor the major Philippine holidays

Start date: on or before November 2, 2026



Salary



$1,300 per month for full-time work (40 hours a week).



Perks and benefits



13th month pay, paid before December 24 every year. In your first year it is pro-rated for the months you have worked with us — you do not have to finish probation to receive it.

A performance review and a raise potential at your twelve-month mark



Training we provide



You do not need to know our exact systems on day one. We will train you on Sierra Interactive, Sisu, DotLoop, and our documented processes. Your first 30 days are built for learning — you will not be dropped onto live files in week one.



Career potential



We are growing our agent count, and our transaction volume grows with it. As it does, this role grows too — into deeper ownership of our data and lead systems, or into leading the support function as we add people to it. We would rather promote someone who already knows how we work than hire over them.



How to apply



Put "Clean Data, Closed Deals" in your subject heading so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us three things:



Your resume or CV.

A short answer to this: describe a time you found and fixed a data or systems problem nobody asked you to look at. What did you find, what did you do, and what changed as a result? A few honest paragraphs beat a polished template — we can tell the difference.

A list of the CRMs you have worked in and what you were actually responsible for inside each one.



If you have questions about the role before you apply, ask them. We would rather answer than have you guess.

title: Short-Form Vertical Video Editing in DaVinci Resolve 21
description:
Hello, fellow video editor,



KIND REMINDER:

- I understand many of you use various LLMs (AI tools) to quickly copy this job post and prepare a reply. But sending me a generic reply with a couple of AP points and calling it a day - will not work. I really need you to have experience in short-form video editing (preferably vertical, for Instagram and TikTok), a legitimate DaVinci Resolve license and your realistic estimate of how much time you would need to edit a 1-minute video, so we can calculate the pricing correctly.

- This means: if you do not have a video portfolio of short-form vertical videos, I will not reply to your application, no matter how many AP points you spend.



WHO I AM:

I'm a certified coach, and I have recently started building my personal brand on Instagram (and TikTok) from scratch. I'm looking for someone to help me edit my short-form videos. These are not simple recordings of me talking - they use chroma key footage with the background removed, and in the background there is a video of me hand-drawing, followed by an animation at the end.



VIDEO FORMAT:

- Vertical, Full HD, 1080x1920, 29.97 fps

- 3 zones: top - title text, middle - drawing background, bottom - my upper body talking, with the background removed

- The drawing is done by hand with my graphics tablet (XP-Pen). I write words and draw symbols or people that match what I'm saying

- The animation is the last frame of the drawing turned into a short moving clip, made with AI (Kling AI)

- No music - just my voice and a few short sound effects

- NO CAPTIONS - captions are not needed



WHAT MY DAVINCI RESOLVE PROJECT LOOKS LIKE:

You will receive an exported DaVinci Resolve project that already has several video tracks with all the parts mentioned above:

1) Chroma key video of me (background already removed in Fusion, using the Delta Keyer node)

2) Drawing video - already timed and matched to what I'm saying

3) Final animation - already connected to the end of the drawing part, lasting the last 5-8 seconds

4) Text titles - no need to touch, already adjusted and placed correctly

5) Background - generated solid color (white), no need to change, the white tone is already set (e.g. #FFFFF2)

6) Audio - my speaking audio plus sound effects



Files: All video files are included in the exported DaVinci Resolve project archive, including the original, unconverted raw footage from my Canon EOS R50V camera.



GOAL:

Use the exported DaVinci Resolve project that I will send you. In the timeline, all 3 parts are already connected, but the size and everything else still need to be adjusted - that is your task:

1) Adjust the size and position of the chroma key video of me, so it is shown correctly at the bottom of the frame

2) Edit the video of me to add effects - zoom in, zoom out, and move up/down at certain intervals (e.g., a slight zoom in for the first 3 seconds, then zoom out, then the biggest zoom on the most important part, zoom out again, and a slight zoom in at the end)

3) Adjust the video's color and quality (e.g., saturation, gain, brightness) using scopes such as waveform/parade

4) Adjust the size of the drawing video if it doesn't fit (usually I leave it at the right size, but sometimes parts need to be zoomed in)

5) Adjust the size of the animation video if it doesn't line up with the end of the drawing part

6) Combine all 3 parts - chroma key video, drawing, and animation - together with the text titles (no need to touch) and all audio

7) Speed up the final composition to
%

8) Double-check the overall quality and make sure everything fits together

9) Export the video and send it to me for approval



If we agree to work together, I can show you examples - I already have 3 completed final videos in exactly this concept and format.



COOPERATION:

- I prefer to pay via Wise (in EUR or USD), this is a long term cooperation project

- I can provide 2, or at most 3, such videos per week, because the drawing part is less predictable and takes the most time

- Most of my videos are about 50-60 seconds long, rarely up to 2 minutes (a 2-minute video can count as 2 videos)

- You are not allowed to post the full videos anywhere. Short clips may only be used for portfolio purposes, and only with my permission (since the main creative work is already done and arranged by me)

- I need your realistic estimate of how much time one video would take, even before you do a test video

- Before we start working together, we can have a short video call where I will briefly show you everything (we have a 6-hour time difference - I am 6 hours behind you, so your evening is my morning)



HOW TO APPLY:

- Please take into account the kind reminder at the beginning of this job post

- Write me how long you have been editing videos in DaVinci Resolve

- Include a link to your portfolio of short-form videos (preferably vertical, for Instagram and TikTok)

- Include your estimated turnaround time for a 1-minute video, for a first review and pricing

- Include any questions you have and/or your available time slots (day and time) for a short video call



Thanks for reading, and I look forward to hearing from you!

title: Inbound Sales & Customer Quote VA | eCommerce + Follow Ups

title: Full-Time Chrome Extension Developer for eCommerce Automation SaaS
description:
I run Dropanion, an eCommerce automation software business focused on online marketplace selling.



The software helps automate a retail-to-marketplace workflow. In simple terms, we take products from retail supplier sites such as Amazon and list them onto online marketplaces such as eBay. • auto listing products

• finding winning products

• tracking inventory and stock status

• helping automate order fulfillment workflows

• managing accounting-related data such as profit sheets and tracking



The product has two main parts:

1. a backend website where users sign up, manage billing, and access their account

2. a Chrome extension that handles much of the browser automation and workflow execution



I already have a developer helping with some backend work, but I am now looking for a full-time developer who can take a major role on the Chrome extension side of the product while also being comfortable with the backend-connected parts that tie into it.

You do not need to be a pure backend engineer, but you should be comfortable understanding and working with backend-connected product logic.

Bonus If You Have Experience With

• automation bots

• Firebase

• Firestore

• Stripe

• GPT or other AI API integrations

• product scraping

• browser workflows involving sites like eBay, Amazon, or similar platforms



How to Apply

When applying, please include:

1. your experience with Chrome extensions

2. your experience with web scraping or browser automation

3. your experience with Firebase / Firestore / APIs if any

4. the AI coding tools you use

description:
We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer with AI experience to build a custom credit improvement/credit repair software platform.



The goal is to create a system where clients can sign up online, upload their information, connect or upload credit reports, receive AI-powered credit analysis, and manage their credit improvement process through a client portal.



Key Features



* Client signup and secure login

* Client dashboard

* Online agreements and e-signatures

* ID and proof-of-address uploads

* Credit report integration or report importing

* AI-powered credit report analysis

* Identify negative accounts, inaccuracies, and areas needing attention

* Generate personalized credit action plans

* Dispute workflow with client/human review and approval

* Track dispute rounds and responses

* Credit score/progress tracking

* Automated client updates and notifications

* Monthly subscription/payment system

* Admin dashboard for our team

* CRM capabilities

* Secure document storage

*
/SMS integrations

* AI chatbot/client assistant



Compliance



The platform should be designed with credit repair compliance in mind, including applicable requirements under the Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA), FCRA, consumer privacy/security requirements, and applicable state laws.



The AI should never fabricate dispute reasons, identity-theft claims, or inaccurate information. Clients and/or authorized staff should be able to review information before disputes or other actions are submitted.



Ideal Candidate



* Strong full-stack development experience

* Experience building SaaS platforms

* Experience integrating AI/LLMs such as OpenAI

Project Goal

description:

THE JOB 

One week you're cleaning up a shaky phone-recorded patient testimonial so it sounds and looks professional. The next week you're building a full campaign video with branded intros, motion graphics, and a proper storyline. Some weeks it's a 30-minute audio clean-up job. Other weeks it's a multi-day production. We need someone who can flex between both without dropping quality on either.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Video Editing

Cleaning up member-shot footage (often smartphone quality) into polished, on-brand videos: testimonials, practice tours, educational content, promos

Colour correction, trimming, basic audio fixes for quick-turnaround jobs

Full productions when briefed: branded intros/outros, motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, CTA overlays

Exporting/optimising for YouTube,
, Instagram,
, and web embeds

Cleaning noisy recordings: removing background noise, levelling volume, improving clarity

Editing podcast episodes and interviews into publish-ready audio

Adding branded intros/outros to audio content



YouTube & Vimeo Management

Uploading and managing videos across member channels: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists, end screens

Managing Vimeo settings: privacy, embed configs

Keeping metadata/branding consistent per member

Flagging any channel issues or comments needing attention



Bigger Projects (when they come up)

Full campaign videos, event coverage edits, multi-asset production briefs

Giving accurate time estimates so we can plan capacity

Delivering work members are proud to put on their own websites and socials



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Solid video editing chops: you can turn rough, imperfect footage into something premium-looking, and you can show us examples

Audio editing skills: noise removal, levelling, podcast/interview editing

Comfortable with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (or similar) for video; Audacity, Adobe Audition (or similar) for audio

Some motion graphics ability: branded intros, lower thirds, overlays (After Effects is a bonus, not required)

Know your way around YouTube and Vimeo channel management

Can juggle multiple client brands without mixing up styles

Subtitling/accessibility experience (captions, SRT files, etc.)

title: Content Writer & Researcher
description:
We're looking for creative, naturally curious writers to join our team for a long-term position.



This is not a traditional SEO writing role.



We're not looking for someone whose writing process is simply checking keywords, analyzing the top-ranking articles, and producing another version of what's already there.



We'll provide the topics and direction. Your job is to take an unfamiliar subject, research it thoroughly, find interesting information and angles, and turn what you discover into an article that's genuinely useful and worth reading.



What We're Looking For

Strong, natural writing

Excellent research skills

Genuine curiosity and willingness to learn

Creative and independent thinking

Ability to make unfamiliar or technical subjects interesting

Good judgment when evaluating sources and information

Attention to detail and fact-checking

Ability to explain complicated ideas clearly

Ability to take feedback and improve

Reliability and consistency



You don't need to be an expert in any particular niche.



In fact, being comfortable researching subjects you've never encountered before is an important part of the job.



We're especially interested in writers who naturally ask questions, go down research rabbit holes, and look beyond the first few results they find online.



What the Work Looks Like



We'll provide you with topics that we've already identified and researched for their potential.



From there, we expect you to think like a writer and researcher rather than simply follow an SEO template.



That might mean finding original sources, studies, reports, datasets, expert opinions, community discussions, firsthand information, or other useful material depending on the topic.



The goal isn't to write an article just because a search engine wants one.



We want to create articles that deserve to rank because they're genuinely useful and interesting.



Using AI



AI tools can be part of your workflow, but we're not looking for someone who generates an article with AI and lightly edits the output.



The research, thinking, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality of your work need to be yours.



We're hiring a writer and researcher, not a prompt operator.



Compensation



Starting salary: $800 USD/month



There is potential to increase this to $1,000 USD/month based on performance.



We're looking for people interested in a serious, long-term position rather than occasional freelance assignments.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid writing trial before we make our final hiring decisions.



How to Apply



Please complete our application form (remove spaces): forms.gle / a2jCwkmEwNTSnMm89



The application includes a few questions about how you think, research, and write, along with two writing samples and a short writing exercise.



Please answer the application questions yourself. Do not use AI to generate your responses. We want to understand how you think and write.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the hiring process.



Applications sent through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the application form will not be considered.
