title: FREIGHT DISPATCH VIRTUAL ASSISTANT | Remote | Full-Time or Part-Time
description:
ABOUT US

We are a rapidly expanding freight and logistics company specializing in nationwide transportation and fleet dispatch operations. Driven by efficiency and strong industry relationships, we manage a growing network of drivers and equipment across key US freight corridors. As an emerging business in the logistics space, we are looking for a proactive, highly organized Freight Dispatch VA to oversee daily dispatching, streamline operational workflows, and support our continued growth.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Source, evaluate, and secure high-paying loads across key freight boards (DAT, TQL Carrier Dashboard) tailored to fleet capacity



Manage active load dispatching, negotiate spot rates with brokers, and verify rate confirmations before routing drivers



Maintain continuous communication with drivers via phone/SMS to provide load details, schedule updates, and route guidance



Perform routine broker check calls and transmit real-time shipment updates to keep stakeholders informed



Oversee post-delivery documentation workflows, collecting and filing Proofs of Delivery (PODs) and Bills of Lading (BOLs) within 24 hours



Record daily operation metrics, updating internal logs for driver pay, load profitability, and active transit statuses



Handle on-the-road operational exceptions (detention, layover, TONU, mechanical breakdowns, route delays) and escalate urgent issues to management



Process broker setup packets, carrier agreements, and administrative compliance paperwork efficiently



REQUIREMENTS



Prior experience in US freight dispatch, truck brokerage, or logistics operations (REQUIRED)

Practical experience using major load boards (DAT, TQL Carrier Dashboard)

Solid understanding of US freight terms (Rate Confirmations, POD, BOL, detention, TONU, check calls, accessorials)

Professional written and verbal English communication skills

Availability to work during US business hours (Central Time preferred)

High attention to detail and reliable home office setup (stable internet connection and computer)

Strong problem-solving ability with minimal supervision required



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with factoring company processes or FMCSA compliance standards

Background dispatching OTR or box truck equipment

Experience using tracking platforms (MacroPoint, Trucker Tools, Samsara)

Effectively communicate with shipment status, process shipping documents, and maintain the office filing system.

Experience in using McLeod, Aljex, and similar TMS is highly preferred.





COMPENSATION



Monthly Salary: $800/month



Bonuses: Performance incentives available based on weekly load volume targets



Payment Terms: Bi-weekly payouts via Wise or direct transfer



Start Date: Immediate



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please submit:



Resume or summary of experience in freight and logistics

A list of dispatch platforms and load boards you are proficient in using

A brief example of a challenge you resolved with a broker or driver

Portfolio if you have one containing proof

Cover letter for experience in freight and logistics



Answer this questions as well: 

1. A truck suffers a blowout mid-transit with 2 hours of HOS left, and the broker threatens fines if the load is late. How do you handle the driver's safety and the broker's expectations?



2. A driver is detained for 6 hours, but the broker claims the shipper won't authorize detention pay and refuses to update the Rate Confirmation. How do you recover the pay without burning the broker relationship?



3. Your driver is stuck in a low-rate lane where outbound loads lose money, but sitting idle costs $300/day. How do you strategize a multi-leg route to keep the carrier profitable?



Note: Applicants without previous freight/logistics experience will not be considered.

title: Operations & Executive Assistant – Real Estate
description:
Hours: Part-Time to Start, with Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time

Schedule: Must overlap substantially with U.S. business hours

Pay: $3.50–$5.00 USD/hour, depending on experience



About the Role



Hi! I own a U.S.-based real estate investment company and am looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Operations & Executive Assistant to join my team long-term.



This is a hands-on operations role that combines administrative support, financial tracking, QuickBooks Online, reporting, and communication with property managers, vendors, tenants, and other business contacts.



This is not a bookkeeping-only role. While accounting support and financial accuracy are important parts of the position, the broader responsibility is helping keep the business organized and moving forward: monitoring outstanding items, following up, communicating with third parties, maintaining accurate records, and taking ownership of recurring responsibilities.



I am looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with numbers, communicating professionally, and following things through to completion.



The position will begin part-time, with the goal of growing into a full-time, long-term role as you learn the business, become proficient in our systems, and take on greater responsibility.



Key Responsibilities

Track rents, mortgage payments, utilities, insurance, invoices, and other recurring financial obligations

Calculate prorated rents, balances, late fees, and payment summaries

Assist with QuickBooks Online updates and bookkeeping-related tasks

Assist with accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, and collections

Support bank and credit card reconciliations and financial reporting

Maintain accurate spreadsheets, reports, and internal tracking systems

Monitor outstanding payments and provide status updates

Identify discrepancies, missing information, and unresolved items and help determine the appropriate next steps

Communicate professionally with property managers, vendors, tenants, and other third parties by phone and

Follow up on outstanding items until they are resolved

Assist with inbox management and general administrative support

Maintain organized company files and documentation in Google Drive

Follow established processes and SOPs while using good judgment

Escalate issues appropriately while continuing to keep projects and responsibilities moving forward

What I'm Looking For



You do not need to know every aspect of this position on your first day. Training will be provided, and I am willing to invest time in someone who is capable, honest about what they know and don't know, and genuinely interested in learning the business.



You should have relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:



QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software

Bookkeeping or accounting support

Accounts receivable/accounts payable

Billing, invoicing, or collections

Financial administration or payment tracking

Administrative or operations support



Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience is strongly preferred. Experience with transaction categorization, bank or credit card reconciliations, journal entries, invoicing, AR/AP, or financial reports is a plus.



Real estate experience is helpful, but not required if you have a strong financial/administrative foundation and are willing to learn.



The Right Person Will Be

Honest and comfortable saying when they don't know something

Highly organized and attentive to details

Proactive about following up rather than waiting to be reminded

Comfortable taking ownership of recurring responsibilities

Able to manage multiple priorities

Comfortable working independently and solving problems

Strong with basic math and financial information

Proficient with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

Clear and professional in both written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating by both phone and

Comfortable following SOPs while exercising good judgment

Interested in a stable, long-term position and growing into greater responsibility over time

Work Schedule & Remote Setup



This position requires substantial overlap with U.S. business hours, which means working overnight hours in the Philippines.



You should have a schedule that allows you to be fully awake, rested, focused, and consistently available during your scheduled working hours.



Because this position involves financial records, multiple systems, calls, and video meetings, you must also have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A reliable computer

Dual monitors

A quiet, professional, distraction-free workspace

A backup internet connection and/or backup power solution

A setup suitable for professional phone and video calls

Comfort using a time-tracking system

Comfort appearing on camera for internal meetings



OnlineJobs.ph ID Proof Score of 80 or higher preferred.



Hours & Compensation



The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours as you become trained and take ownership of more responsibilities.



The long-term goal is for this position to grow into approximately 40 hours per week.



Starting compensation is $3.50–$5.00 USD/hour, depending on relevant experience and current skill level.



I believe in developing good employees and building long-term working relationships. As you become proficient, work more independently, and take on greater responsibility, there will be opportunities to review both your responsibilities and compensation.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the phrase:



“I read the full post.”



Then please provide:



Your resume

A short video introduction

Internet speed test screenshot

1-minute typing test screenshot showing both speed and accuracy

Your current employment status. If you currently work for any other employers or clients, please include approximately how many hours per week you work for them.

The U.S. business hours you are consistently available to work.

Please describe exactly what you have personally done in QuickBooks Online or another accounting system. Which tasks can you perform independently today, and which would you still need training on?

Tell me about one specific payment, invoice, accounting, or financial discrepancy you personally caught in a previous position. What was wrong, how did you discover it, and what did you do to resolve it?

Imagine you realize on Friday that an important payment or task that should have been completed earlier in the week is still outstanding, but your manager has not noticed it. What would you do?

Please confirm that you have a dual-monitor setup and a quiet workspace suitable for professional calls and video meetings.

Please briefly describe your backup internet and/or backup power setup.

Please confirm that you are comfortable with time tracking.



If you provide Google Drive links, please check the sharing settings before submitting your application to make sure the files can be opened without requesting access.



I'm looking for someone who wants to learn the business, become an important part of the team, and stay long-term. If that sounds like what you're looking for, I'd be happy to hear from you.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
We are looking for an energetic and commercially minded **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** based in the Philippines to help grow our UK customer base.



We provide businesses with an **all-in-one HR and people platform combined with access to experienced HR and business consultants**. Our solution helps organisations manage their people more effectively, reduce HR administration, improve compliance and develop their managers and employees.



### The Role



Your primary responsibility is simple: **create quality sales conversations with UK businesses.**



You will identify and contact decision-makers within companies, understand their current HR challenges and introduce our software and consultancy solutions where there is a genuine opportunity.



This is primarily an **outbound B2B sales and appointment-setting role**.



You will:



* Research and identify suitable UK companies and decision-makers.

* Contact CEOs, Managing Directors, HR Directors, Heads of People, Finance Directors and other senior leaders.

* Make outbound telephone calls to prospective customers.

* Use
 and LinkedIn to support your outreach.

* Work from prospect lists and lead-generation tools provided by us.

* Introduce our HR software, HR consultancy and related people solutions.

* Ask good questions to understand the prospect's current situation and challenges.

* Qualify genuine sales opportunities.

* Book qualified meetings and demonstrations directly into our team's calendars.

* Follow up prospects who are interested but not yet ready to meet.

* Keep accurate records of conversations, activities and opportunities within our CRM.

* Work closely with our UK team to continuously improve messaging, targeting and conversion.



### Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is **confident speaking to senior business people on the telephone**.



You should have:



* Previous B2B outbound sales, telesales, SDR or appointment-setting experience.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* A confident and professional telephone manner.

* Experience making cold calls.

* The ability to build rapport quickly.

* Good questioning and listening skills.

* Confidence handling objections and rejection.

* Strong organisation and follow-up skills.

* Experience using CRM, LinkedIn and prospecting tools.

* A reliable internet connection and suitable remote-working environment.

* The ability to work UK business hours.



Experience selling **HR software, SaaS, business software, professional services, recruitment, HR services or consultancy** would be particularly valuable.



### What We Provide



You won't be expected to figure everything out yourself.



We provide:



* Target customer profiles.

* Prospecting and lead-generation tools.

* Sales training.

* Product and HR industry training.

* Messaging and sales playbooks.

* CRM and sales systems.

* Ongoing coaching from the UK team.

* Clear targets and performance measures.



### Compensation



**£500 GBP monthly base salary + commission.**



There is **no cap on commission**. Strong performance will therefore significantly increase your total earnings.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business. As we expand our sales operation, there will be opportunities for high performers to take on greater responsibility.



### What Success Looks Like



We are not interested in activity for activity's sake.



Success means:



**Good prospects → quality conversations → qualified meetings → new customers.**



If you enjoy speaking to people, are comfortable picking up the phone, like working towards targets and want your earnings to increase with your performance, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Local SEO Specialist – Google Maps, GBP & AI Search
description:
Home Remodeling & General Construction Company – Los Angeles County



Job Type: Part-Time or Full-Time

Location: Remote – Philippines preferred

Compensation: Based on experience, demonstrated results, and agreed hours/scope. Please include your expected monthly compensation and available hours per week in your application. 

Employment Type: Long-Term



ABOUT THE COMPANY



We are a home remodeling and general construction company serving Los Angeles County and the greater Los Angeles area.

Our primary focus is on larger residential projects, including:

New construction

Whole-home remodeling

ADU construction, including garage conversions and new ADUs

Home additions

Second-story additions

Kitchen remodeling

We are looking for an experienced SEO specialist who can take ownership of our local search strategy and help turn Google and other search platforms into a consistent source of qualified leads.

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are NOT looking for a generic SEO person whose primary focus is writing blog posts or building large quantities of backlinks.

We are looking for someone with strong, hands-on experience in:

Local SEO

Google Maps / Local Pack ranking

Google Business Profile optimization

Google organic SEO

Technical SEO

Keyword research

Competitor research

Local citations

Quality local link building

Content strategy and SEO writing

WordPress

Schema / structured data

Google Search Console

Google Analytics / GA4

Conversion tracking

Entity and semantic SEO

AI search / AI SEO

Google AI Overviews

ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and similar AI search platforms

Experience specifically with contractors, remodeling companies, home builders, ADU companies, or other home-service businesses is strongly preferred.

Experience ranking businesses in competitive U.S. markets is a major advantage.



HOW WE WILL EVALUATE CANDIDATES



We are looking for someone who can actually execute SEO—not simply someone who can talk about SEO or provide generic recommendations.

The hiring process may include a practical SEO assessment and a live working session. Candidates may be asked to demonstrate their ability to research, analyze, strategize, and execute tasks related to Local SEO, Google Maps/Google Business Profile, organic SEO, content, link building, and AI search visibility.

We are particularly interested in seeing how you approach real-world problems, prioritize opportunities, use SEO tools, and turn research into actionable work.

Strong communication and experience are important, but our hiring decision will be based heavily on demonstrated ability and the quality of your actual work.



OUR GOAL



Our ultimate goal is qualified leads and revenue.

We want to improve our visibility across:

Google organic search

Google Maps / Local Pack

Google Business Profile

Google AI Overviews

ChatGPT

Gemini

Claude

Perplexity

Bing and other search engines

Relevant local and industry websites

We understand nobody can guarantee that an AI platform will recommend a company.

We want someone who understands how to build the authority, relevance, entity signals, content, citations, mentions, and overall online presence that can increase our visibility across traditional and AI-powered search.



CURRENT SITUATION



We currently have:

A WordPress website with approximately 5–6 pages

A verified Google Business Profile

Approximately 50 Google reviews

Little to no meaningful organic visibility

Little to no meaningful Google Maps visibility

No reliable history of organic lead generation from Google

Previous SEO work that lasted approximately four months and produced only one known lead

A previous SEO provider may have built approximately 400 backlinks, although we are not certain of the exact work performed

The first phase will include a thorough audit of our website, GBP, rankings, backlinks, citations, competitors, tracking, and previous SEO work.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for developing and implementing our overall SEO strategy.

This includes:

Local SEO strategy

Google Business Profile optimization

Google Maps ranking strategy

Keyword and competitor research

Technical SEO

On-page SEO

Website architecture

Internal linking

Service pages

Location pages

Service + location opportunities

SEO content strategy and writing

Schema and structured data

Local citations

Quality link building

Local authority building

Competitor analysis

AI search visibility

Conversion optimization

Lead tracking and attribution

Ongoing testing and optimization

We want someone who can research, develop a strategy, explain it to us, obtain approval when appropriate, and then actually implement it.



CONTENT



You will be responsible for developing and writing SEO content.

Content must be:

Original

Useful to homeowners

Professionally written

Locally relevant

Based on actual search intent

Designed to generate qualified leads

Optimized without keyword stuffing or sounding robotic

Major content will be reviewed and approved by us before publication.

AI tools may be used as part of your workflow, but we are not interested in mass-producing generic AI content.



WEBSITE



Our website is currently small, so there will likely be significant opportunities to improve its SEO structure, content, and conversion performance.

You should be capable of implementing SEO-related changes in WordPress.

Website design and development are NOT the primary focus of this position.

However, WordPress, web design, HTML/CSS, development, UX, and conversion optimization skills are a significant plus.



GOOGLE MAPS / GBP



Google Maps visibility is a major priority.

You should be capable of managing and improving:

GBP categories

Services

Business information

Service areas

GBP content

Photos

Reviews and review strategy

Q&A

Local citations

Local backlinks

Local relevance

Competitor positioning

Map Pack rankings



LINK BUILDING



We want quality over quantity.

We are NOT interested in:

Spammy backlinks

Mass directory links

Automated link building

Manipulative tactics

Low-quality guest posting

Tactics that could damage our reputation

We are interested in relevant local, industry, authority, PR, partnership, and other legitimate link opportunities.



WEEKLY REPORTING



You will provide professional weekly reports showing:

Ranking changes

Google Maps rankings

Organic traffic

Search Console performance

GBP performance

Leads and conversions

Work completed

Links/citations acquired

Content published

Problems identified

Priorities for the following week

We care about rankings, but ultimately we care about qualified leads and revenue.



VERIFIABLE EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



Please provide at least 2–3 real SEO case studies.

For each case study, provide:

Business name

Website URL

Location

Industry

Services targeted

What you personally did

Starting point

Ranking improvements

Google Maps/GBP improvements, if applicable

Traffic improvements, if available

Lead/conversion improvements, if available

Approximate timeframe

Current results

We will verify the businesses and websites.

Experience with contractors, remodeling companies, home builders, ADU companies, or other home-service businesses is strongly preferred.



OWNERSHIP & LEAD CONTROL



The company must maintain ownership and administrative access to all business assets and accounts.

This includes the website, WordPress, Google Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics, tracking systems, citations, content, reports, SEO data, and other digital assets.

You may be given access necessary to perform your work, but you will not be the sole owner or administrator of our digital assets.

All inbound leads, calls, forms, estimate requests, and customer information must remain under our control.

You will not be the sole person with access to our leads, and leads may not be redirected, resold, distributed, claimed, or used for another company or client.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Start your application with:

"LA LOCAL SEO"

Then answer the following:

How many years of Local SEO and Google Maps/Google Business Profile experience do you have?

How many contractors, remodeling companies, home-service businesses, or similar businesses have you personally worked with?

Provide 2–3 real, verifiable case studies with website URLs. Please briefly explain what you personally did and the results achieved.

What would you audit during your first 2–4 weeks with our company?

How would you approach improving a Google Business Profile with approximately 50 reviews but little/no Map Pack visibility?

What is your current understanding of AI search optimization and visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar platforms?

How would you approach the approximately 400 backlinks potentially created by our previous SEO provider?

What SEO tools do you personally use, and what is your skill level with them?

What would your first 90 days look like?

What monthly compensation would you expect, and approximately how many hours per week would you dedicate to this account?

Would you recommend starting part-time or full-time? Why?

Please provide specific answers rather than generic SEO terminology.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate real results, think strategically, execute independently, communicate professionally, and build a long-term organic lead-generation system.

If you have successfully ranked local businesses in competitive U.S. markets and can demonstrate real results, we want to hear from you.

Candidates who advance to the next stage will be asked to complete a more detailed practical SEO assessment.

title: E-commerce Product Assistant – Shopify & Lightspeed
description:
We are Kidstuff, an established family-owned children's retail store in New Zealand, and we are looking for a reliable and detail-focused E-commerce Product Assistant to join our team remotely.



Our main requirement is someone who can help us accurately enter new products into our Lightspeed inventory system and then complete and prepare those products for our Shopify online store.



Your main responsibilities will include:



Lightspeed



Entering new products from supplier information

Creating product names and variants

Entering SKUs, supplier codes and barcodes

Creating and improving product titles and descriptions

Adding sizes, colours and other variants

Adding brands, suppliers and categories

Entering cost and retail prices

Carefully checking product information for accuracy



Shopify



Completing products after they have been created in Lightspeed



Uploading and arranging product images

Adding tags and other product information

Checking products carefully before they are ready to be published



Canva / Images



Basic editing, cropping and resizing of product images

Preparing clean and consistent product images for our website



Who we are looking for



You should have:



Good Shopify experience or previous e-commerce/product-listing experience

Excellent attention to detail

Good written English

Basic image-editing skills

Good computer and data-entry skills

Experience using spreadsheets

The ability to follow detailed instructions and processes

The confidence to ask questions when information is unclear



Experience with Lightspeed Retail would be a strong advantage. However, we are happy to train the right person if you already have good e-commerce experience and are a careful learner.



Accuracy is extremely important to us. We would much rather you ask us a question than guess when information is missing or unclear.



We will provide training and step-by-step procedures showing how we want our products entered and presented.



Initially, product entry will be your main responsibility. As you learn our business and we build trust, we may train you in additional areas and give you more responsibilities (more hours)



We are hoping to find someone who would like to become a long-term member of our team, rather than someone looking for a short-term project.



When applying, please tell us:

How much experience you have with Shopify.

What kind of product-management work you have previously done.

Whether you have used Lightspeed Retail or another POS/inventory system.

What experience you have using Canva or other image editing apps

What e-commerce businesses or product categories you have previously worked with.

Your normal working hours and availability.

Please note hours will increase closer to Christmas time. 



We can be reasonably flexible with working hours, however at the start you will need to be available during our opening hours so we can train you. Our opening hours are 9am-5pm NZ time. 



Please begin your application with the words KIDS RETAIL so we know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small paid product-entry test before we make our final decision.

title: Chat Specialist/Customer Support | Join Our Remote Team at Dealer Media! | Full-Time + Benefits
description:
Are you someone who types fast, notices the little details, and takes pride in doing great work?

If you’re trustworthy, independent, and love clear communication — we want to hear from you!

title: Commercial Furniture Designer (CET Designer)
description:
About the Opportunity

We're hiring on behalf of an established U.S. commercial interiors company. Their design and sales teams deliver real commercial workplace projects across the U.S., including offices, collaboration spaces, and full workplace fit-outs.



The Role

You'll be an extension of the internal design team. Day to day, you'll be working in CET Designer to produce space plans, specifications, and presentation materials that go straight to clients and installers. Some days you'll own a small project end to end. Other days you'll be supporting senior designers with rendering and presentation work on larger projects.

This is technical, accuracy-driven design work, the kind where a wrong part number or a missed clearance becomes a real problem on the install floor. If you take pride in clean, buildable, error-free drawing sets, you'll do well here.



What You'll Do

Develop space plans and furniture layouts in CET Designer

Take on small design projects independently, from initial layout through final documentation

Specify commercial furniture products, finishes, and accessories

Support internal designers with renderings, presentation boards, and client-facing visuals

Produce client proposals, bills of materials, validation packages, and installation drawings

Review specifications for accuracy, completeness, clearances, product application, and installation requirements

Revise projects based on feedback from Sales, Design, clients, and manufacturers

Maintain organized project files and follow established drawing, documentation, and quality-control standards

Communicate proactively with the U.S. team on priorities, deadlines, questions, and project status

Manage multiple projects at once and consistently hit deadlines



What We're Looking For



Required

Degree in interior design, architecture, or a related field, with a portfolio you can share

3 to 5 years of professional design experience

Completed CET Designer training and comfortable working in CET day to day

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft 365

Strong written English and clear, proactive communication

Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team

Reliable computer and internet setup capable of running CET Designer smoothly

Availability for consistent working-hour overlap with the U.S. team



Preferred

Experience with commercial interiors, contract furniture, space planning, or furniture specification

Familiarity with manufacturer-specific CET extensions (Steelcase, MillerKnoll, Haworth, Teknion, Kimball, etc.)

Experience producing SIF files, BOMs, or dealer-side documentation

Working knowledge of ADA and life-safety clearance requirements



Who Succeeds Here

A dependable, technically capable designer who is receptive to feedback and committed to producing accurate, installation-ready work. You ask questions early rather than guessing, you double-check your own specs before they go out, and you keep the team in the loop without being chased for updates.



What's Offered

Full-time, long-term role with a growing U.S. commercial interiors company

Real project ownership, not just production support

Direct collaboration with an experienced U.S. design and sales team

Exposure to major commercial furniture brands and current workplace design standards

Negotiable rate for candidates with strong CET experience



How to Apply

All applications must be submitted through our application form:



Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



Before you start, have the following ready:

Your resume/CV

Your design portfolio (PDF or link, such as Google Drive, Behance, or a personal site)

Which CET Designer extensions you've worked in, and how long you've used CET

A short description of a commercial project you specified or space-planned, and your role in it

Your working-hours availability relative to U.S. Pacific Time

Your expected hourly rate

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to schedule an interview with the team.

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and evolving digital marketing systems, with a proactive approach to staying updated on and exploring emerging industry trends.

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking)

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands

Experience optimizing
 revenue and customer retention funnels

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required

Must be fully available for US hours



What We Offer

Full-time remote role

Training provided

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions.

All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. The shortlisted will receive an
 invite for the next steps.

title: SEO Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a sharp, reliable Appointment Setter to support an SEO and digital marketing sales operation.



This is not a high-volume cold-calling role where you are expected to blindly dial hundreds of businesses.



We use a research-driven outbound process. Our system identifies businesses with specific SEO and local-search opportunities, analyzes their websites and competitors, and gives you real information you can use when speaking with prospects.



Your job is to turn that interest and outreach into qualified appointments for our sales team.



What You'll Do

Follow up with businesses from our outbound campaigns

Respond quickly to interested prospects

Call qualified business leads when appropriate

Use company-specific SEO findings to create relevant conversations

Explain the opportunity in simple business terms — you do not need to be an SEO expert

Qualify prospects before booking meetings

Schedule qualified appointments directly onto the sales calendar

Follow up consistently with prospects who have shown interest

Keep accurate notes and update prospect status in our CRM

Help identify which messaging and approaches are generating the best responses

What We're Looking For



You should have:



Strong spoken and written English

Previous appointment-setting, sales, lead-generation, or outbound experience

Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

Good listening skills

Ability to have a real conversation instead of simply reading a script

Strong follow-up habits

Good organization and attention to detail

Reliable internet and a professional work environment

Comfort using CRMs,
, calling tools, and online sales software



Experience selling or setting appointments for any of the following is a plus:



SEO

digital marketing

websites

SaaS

local-business services

B2B services



You do not need to be an SEO expert. We will provide the positioning, research, prospect information, and talking points you need.



How Our Process Is Different



Before contacting a business, we analyze its website and local competitive market.



For example, you may be able to tell an HVAC company:



where its website is weaker than leading local competitors;

what SEO opportunities we identified;

what competitors are doing differently;

and what specific changes could improve its visibility.



This means you have a legitimate reason to start the conversation rather than making a generic sales pitch.



We want someone who can take that information and turn it into a natural conversation with the business owner.



Compensation



$8 USD per hour



This is intended to begin as a part-time position with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibility based on performance.



We are looking for someone we can work with consistently, not someone for a short-term project.



How Success Is Measured



We care about qualified meetings, not meaningless activity.



A successful appointment should be with a legitimate decision-maker who:



understands why we contacted them;

has a potential need for the service;

is interested in discussing the opportunity;

and actually shows up for the scheduled meeting.



Quality matters more than simply putting appointments on a calendar.



How to Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction about yourself.

Your appointment-setting or sales experience.

Any experience working with U.S. businesses.

Any experience with SEO, digital marketing, SaaS, or B2B services.

A short voice recording introducing yourself as if you were speaking to a U.S. business owner.

Your normal working availability in Philippine time.

The CRM and sales tools you have used before.



At the top of your application, write:



“SEO SETTER”



so we know you read the full posting.



We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, follows up consistently, thinks on their feet, and can become a reliable part of the sales operation.  If you do not send a voice recording sample, you will not be considered.

title: Digital Marketing & Local SEO Specialist – Google Business Profile, SEO & Website
description:
Digital Marketing, SEO & AI Search Specialist – Website, Local SEO & Google Business Profile



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time 15–25 Hours/Week | Long-Term



Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience



Hunt Glass is a growing U.S.-based mobile auto glass company looking for an experienced Digital Marketing, SEO & AI Search Specialist to help us build a powerful online presence as we expand into additional U.S. markets.



We are looking for someone who understands both traditional search and where online search is going next.



We want Hunt Glass to be easy to find when customers:



- Search Google

- Search Google Maps

- Ask AI-powered search tools for recommendations

- Research auto glass companies online

- Search for windshield replacement and related services in their local area



This position will begin at approximately 15–25 hours per week, with significant opportunity to grow—and potentially become full-time—as Hunt Glass expands.



Our Goal



We aren't interested in SEO simply for the purpose of generating traffic.



Our goal is:



Visibility → Qualified Leads → Scheduled Jobs → Revenue



We want someone who thinks about marketing in terms of actual business results.



1. Website Development & Conversion Optimization



One of your largest initial responsibilities will be continuing to build and improve our website.



You will help:



- Build new website pages and landing pages

- Improve existing pages

- Create service-specific pages

- Create high-quality geographic/service-area pages

- Improve website structure and navigation

- Improve mobile usability

- Improve page speed and technical performance

- Improve calls to action

- Improve conversion rates

- Improve trust and credibility

- Help make our website look like a major professional brand

- Turn visitors into phone calls, quote requests, and scheduled jobs



We don't just want a beautiful website.



We want a website that produces customers.



2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)



You will help develop and execute our long-term organic search strategy.



Responsibilities may include:



- Keyword research

- Competitor research

- On-page SEO

- Technical SEO

- Local SEO

- Internal linking

- Search-optimized service pages

- Geographic/service-area content

- Google Search Console

- SEO performance tracking

- Identifying new search opportunities

- Improving rankings for high-value searches

- Building legitimate backlinks and online authority

- Improving our overall domain and brand authority



Experience working with U.S. local service businesses is strongly preferred.



3. Google Business Profile & Local SEO



Strong Google Business Profile experience is very important to us.



Hunt Glass currently operates primarily as a mobile/service-area business. As the company expands, we expect to establish additional legitimate physical operating locations and make local search an increasingly important customer-acquisition channel.



We want someone who understands:



- Google Business Profile optimization

- Service-area businesses

- Multi-location local SEO

- Google Maps rankings

- Categories and services

- Photos and profile content

- Legitimate review-generation strategies

- Local citations

- Local competitor research

- Local ranking tracking

- Google's Business Profile eligibility requirements

- How to avoid tactics that could result in suspension



We are not interested in fake locations, fake reviews, keyword stuffing, or risky shortcuts.



We want to build a legitimate, sustainable local-search presence that can eventually scale across many locations.



4. AI Search Optimization / GEO / AEO



Traditional Google search is no longer the only way customers discover businesses.



We also want Hunt Glass to become increasingly visible when consumers use AI-powered search and recommendation tools to d
 which local businesses to use.



Experience with AI Search Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and/or Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is a major plus.



We want someone who is interested in helping Hunt Glass become a business that AI systems can easily:



Discover → Understand → Trust → Accurately Represent → Recommend when relevant



This may include:



- Creating useful, authoritative content that directly answers customer questions

- Improving website structure and machine-readable information

- Structured data/schema implementation

- Maintaining accurate and consistent business information across reputable online sources

- Building legitimate local citations

- Building brand authority

- Digital PR and outreach

- Earning relevant third-party mentions

- Earning legitimate backlinks

- Developing content that can serve as a useful source for search engines and AI systems

- Monitoring how Hunt Glass appears in AI-generated answers

- Testing searches and prompts relevant to our customers

- Researching how competitors appear in AI search

- Identifying sources that AI systems rely upon in our industry and local markets

- Tracking changes in AI-powered search

- Testing strategies and measuring results



We understand that AI search optimization is a rapidly developing field.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply added "GEO" or "AI SEO" to their résumé because it is a popular new term.



We want someone who understands the underlying principles of authority, relevance, structured information, reputation, useful content, third-party validation, and brand visibility—and who actively studies how AI is changing customer discovery.



5. Online Authority, Mentions & Digital PR



We don't want Hunt Glass's online presence to consist only of Hunt Glass talking about itself.



As we grow, we want to build legitimate authority across the internet.



You may help identify opportunities for:



- Relevant business directories

- Local citations

- Industry websites

- Business partnerships

- Community partnerships

- Local media coverage

- Digital PR

- Partner website mentions

- Guest contributions

- Legitimate backlinks

- Other reputable third-party references to Hunt Glass



Our goal is to build a strong online brand that both people and search technologies have good reason to trust.



6. Analytics, Tracking & Lead Attribution



We want to know where our customers actually come from.



You should be comfortable helping us track:



- Website traffic

- Organic search traffic

- Google Business Profile activity

- Phone calls

- Quote requests

- Form submissions

- Leads

- Scheduled jobs

- Conversion rates

- Advertising leads

- Cost per lead

- Cost per acquired customer

- Search rankings

- Local rankings

- AI-search visibility where reasonably measurable



Ultimately, we want to understand:



Marketing Source → Lead → Scheduled Job → Revenue



We want decisions based on data rather than guesses.



7. Paid Advertising Support



Experience with Google Ads is a plus, but you do not need to be our primary Google Ads expert.



We may use a specialized Google Ads professional for higher-level PPC strategy.



You may work with our advertising and social-media team on:



- Landing pages

- Conversion tracking

- Analytics

- Website changes

- Keyword research

- Reporting

- SEO/PPC coordination



Experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising is also a plus.



AI Experience Is Important



We strongly encourage intelligent use of AI throughout this position.



We want someone who knows how to use modern AI tools to accomplish significantly more without sacrificing quality.



AI may assist with:



- Research

- Keyword analysis

- Competitor research

- SEO analysis

- Content planning

- Website development

- Schema/structured-data work

- Data analysis

- Reporting

- Outreach research

- Automation

- Testing AI-search visibility



We are not looking for someone who simply generates hundreds of low-quality AI articles.



AI should make excellent work faster—not replace strategy, judgment, originality, or quality.



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate:



- Has strong SEO experience

- Understands local SEO

- Has Google Business Profile experience

- Is comfortable building and improving websites

- Understands technical SEO

- Understands how online authority and backlinks work

- Is interested in AI-powered search

- Actively follows changes in SEO and AI search

- Is analytical and data-driven

- Is extremely organized

- Takes initiative

- Can research unfamiliar problems independently

- Communicates well in English

- Is comfortable with numbers

- Uses AI intelligently

- Focuses on measurable business results

- Wants to grow with a company long-term



We Do NOT Expect You to Be an Expert at Everything



This is important.



We would rather hire someone who is exceptional at several of these areas and honest about the others than someone who claims to be an expert in everything.



Please tell us which areas you consider yourself:



Exceptional at



Experienced at



Still learning



Compensation & Hours



$4–$6 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability



Approximately 15–25 hours per week initially



As Hunt Glass expands into additional markets and physical operating locations, this position has the potential to grow significantly and potentially become full-time.



Exceptional performance can lead to increased hours, responsibility, and compensation.



We are looking for a long-term team member, not someone to complete a short-term SEO project.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Describe your SEO experience.



2. Describe your local SEO experience.



3. Describe your experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles.



4. Have you worked with U.S.-based local service businesses? Give specific examples.



5. Provide examples of websites you personally worked on and explain exactly what you did.



6. Show us measurable SEO or local-search results you personally helped achieve. Include actual numbers whenever possible.



7. Show us examples of Google Business Profiles you have worked on and explain what you did and what results you achieved.



8. Which website platforms are you comfortable using?



9. Describe your experience with technical SEO and structured data/schema.



10. Describe your experience with Google Analytics and Google Search Console.



11. Describe your experience with conversion tracking and call tracking.



12. Tell us about your backlink-building, online authority, citation, outreach, or digital-PR experience.



13. Tell us about your experience with AI Search Optimization, GEO, or AEO.



14. Have you ever helped a company become more visible or mentioned in AI-generated search answers or recommendations? If yes, explain what you did and how you measured it.



15. Which AI-powered search platforms or tools do you actively follow or test?



16. If you were trying to make a local service company more likely to appear when consumers ask AI for recommendations, what would your strategy be?



17. Which three areas of this job are you strongest at?



18. Which areas would you need additional training or experience in?



19. Which AI tools do you currently use in your work? Give specific examples of how they improve your productivity or results.



20. Imagine you joined a growing mobile auto glass company today. What would you prioritize during your first 30 days, and why?



21. What is your desired hourly rate?



22. How many hours per week are you currently available?



Important



Please do not send us a generic application.



We care much more about real examples, measurable results, problem-solving ability, and demonstrated skill than certificates or impressive-sounding job titles.



If you have screenshots, reports, ranking improvements, websites, Google Business Profiles, case studies, or other evidence demonstrating your results, please include them.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Hunt Glass and eventually play an important role in building our visibility across Google, Google Maps, traditional search, AI-powered search, and multiple U.S. markets.

title: Direct Response Video Editor | Meta Ads | DTC Brand | Long-Term
description:
Direct Response Video Editor | Meta Ads | DTC Brand | Long-Term



We’re hiring **one direct response video editor** to join a small creative team whose work has driven **eight figures in DTC revenue**.



This is a long-term role for someone who already understands Meta ads and wants to get significantly better at performance creative.



**We don’t hire often. When we open a seat on this team, it’s because we’re looking for someone we can invest in for the long term.**



You’ll see the numbers behind your work, learn why certain ads scale, and earn **performance bonuses when your creative becomes a scaled winner**.



We sell products people use every day to sleep better and regulate their nervous system. We’re growing quickly, which means meaningful ad spend, high creative volume, and plenty of opportunities for your work to get tested.



**This is not a brand-film editing role.** We ship creative, read the data, kill what loses, and iterate what wins.



## The Work



You’ll typically produce **15 to 30 ad variants per week** from UGC, founder-led footage, product b-roll, statics, AI-generated assets, and existing winners.



A large share of that is hook variations and remixes rather than 30 completely new builds.



You should be able to take a written brief and produce **three strong executions without needing a call**.



## Craft Matters



A lot of performance brands accept that direct response creative has to look cheap.



We don’t.



The ad still needs to convert, but pacing, sound design, typography, framing, and attention to detail matter here.



We want performance creative that feels native to Meta without making the brand look disposable.



## Growth & Development



We want this to be a role you can grow with.



You’ll get direct feedback on your creative, visibility into how your ads perform, and access to the same tools, courses, and resources we use to sharpen our own creative thinking.



We invest in **paid industry courses, AI tools, creative software, and training** where they help you improve, whether that means becoming a stronger editor, learning new production workflows, or understanding more of the strategy behind winning ads.



Both founders started as editors, so we know how valuable it is to keep developing your craft while gradually building a broader understanding of performance creative.



As you grow, there’s also room to take on more ownership across hooks, angles, concepts, and strategy if that’s a direction you want to explore.



## You’ll Thrive Here If



You are genuinely interested in ecommerce and performance marketing.



You watch other brands’ ads and think about why the hook works, where attention drops, and how you would improve the next variation.



You want to understand the account, not just receive files and export edits.



We’re a small team. We expect **taste, speed, reliability, and curiosity**.



## Do Not Apply If



* You have never edited an ad that ran on Meta with real spend

* Your portfolio is mainly weddings, music videos, YouTube long-form, or corporate work

* You need a call to understand a clear written brief

* You are looking for one-off project work

* You outsource your edits



We are hiring **you, not your team**.



## Tools



Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. CapCut fluency is expected.



We also use **Higgsfield and ElevenLabs** for AI-generated assets and voiceover, alongside 
, Slack, Foreplay, and Google Drive.



Clean file organisation is **non-negotiable**.



## Pay



Competitive monthly retainer, long-term.



Compensation is reviewed after **60 days** and again at **six months**, with increases for people who improve and take ownership.



You’ll also receive a **performance bonus on ads that become scaled winners**.



Exact compensation will be discussed once we’ve reviewed your work.



## Trial



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small trial based on a real creative brief.



We want to see how you interpret direction, the standard you hold yourself to, and how much you genuinely want the opportunity.



The scope and any compensation for the trial will be agreed upfront before you begin.



## To Apply



Start your proposal with the word **orange**.



Anything that does not begin with it will be archived unread.



Then send:



1. **Three Meta Ad Library links** to ads you personally edited that ran with real spend.

2. **Your realistic weekly output** at consistent quality.

3. **One example of an ad you made using AI-generated assets**, including the tools used.

4. **Your favourite ad you have made**



No agency showreels or generic portfolios.



Keep it short. We’re reading for **signal, taste, and experience, not length**.

title: Application Software Developer
description:
Position Overview

Gordon Sinclair is seeking an experienced and motivated Application Software Developer to join our Information Technology team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, integrating, and supporting enterprise applications with a primary focus on Oracle NetSuite ERP in a manufacturing and distribution environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable.

ERP & Enterprise Systems

● Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

● CRM systems

Manufacturing & Distribution Knowledge

Manufacturing best practices, Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement methodologies, inventory optimization, production planning, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Bill of Materials (BOM), warehouse operations, distribution workflows, supply chain management, and logistics and fulfillment.

Development Technologies

● JSON

eCommerce (Preferred but Not Required)

Desired Competencies

Success in This Role

The successful candidate will:

Why Gordon Sinclair?

# Executive Assistant / Marketing Operations Assistant — HighLevel Experience Required



**Part-Time | Long-Term | Right-Hand Support Role**



I own a growing marketing agency and am looking for a highly organized, proactive person who can become a **right-hand assistant** to me.



This is a combination of **Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Marketing Assistant, and Project Coordinator**.



I have a lot of projects and ideas happening at once. I need someone who can help me organize them, take ownership of smaller projects, follow up on things, and make sure tasks actually get finished.



I am NOT looking for someone who needs a detailed checklist every morning.



I'm looking for someone who can take something off my plate and **own it from beginning to end.**



## What You'll Help With



### Administrative & Executive Support



* Help manage and organize my

* Identify
s that require my attention

* Draft simple responses

* Follow up on outstanding
s and projects

* Maintain task lists and project trackers

* Research vendors, tools, competitors, businesses, and other information

* Help coordinate appointments and calendar items

* Create and maintain simple SOPs

### Small Projects & Project Coordination



I frequently have projects where I need someone who can simply take ownership.



For example, I may say:



**"I need this researched and organized by Friday."**



I want someone who can determine what needs to happen, ask questions when necessary, and get it done.



Projects could include:

* Updating documents

* Coordinating with contractors

* Preparing information for meetings

* Creating checklists and processes

## Marketing Support



Because I own a marketing agency, many of the projects will involve marketing.



You may help with:

* HighLevel Social Planner

* Content research

Please describe exactly what you've done inside HighLevel when applying.

* Matching receipts and transactions

* Maintaining spreadsheets

* Identifying missing transactions

* Organizing records for review



You do **not** need to be an accountant.



Experience with bookkeeping, QuickBooks, or account reconciliation is a plus.



**Accuracy and confidentiality are extremely important.**



## What I'm REALLY Looking For



The biggest thing I'm looking for is **initiative and follow-through**.



I don't want to constantly ask:



**"Did this get done?"**



Ideally, I give you a project and you come back to me saying:



**"It's done. Here's what I found, here's what I recommend, and here's what we need to do next."**



I need someone who is comfortable reminding **me** when I'm holding something up too.



You should be:

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Resourceful

* Proactive

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable researching and figuring things out

* Comfortable working independently

title: SEO Specialist & Website Manager
description:
We're a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, websites, content and lead generation for contractors and home service businesses.



We're looking for an experienced SEO Engineer & Website Manager to join our team in a long-term, full-time position.



This is not an entry-level role, and this is not a checklist-following VA position.



We're looking for someone who understands how websites, SEO, local search, structured data and modern AI-driven search work together — someone who can look at a website or task, understand the goal, identify what is missing or wrong, and make smart decisions without needing every step spelled out.



You should be comfortable saying:



**“I found the problem, here's why it's happening, and here's what I recommend we do.”**



Not:



**“Please tell me exactly what to do next.”**



What You'll Do



You will help own the technical and execution side of SEO and website management across multiple U.S.-based client accounts.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Manage ongoing WordPress website updates and SEO implementation

* Work extensively in **WordPress, Elementor and WP Engine**

* Perform on-page SEO optimizations, including:



  * title tags and meta descriptions

  * headings and page structure

  * internal linking

  * external linking

  * image optimization

  * content formatting

  * service and location-page optimization

  * indexing and canonical checks

* Review websites for missing, outdated, thin or poorly optimized content and proactively flag what needs attention

* Implement approved website content rather than allowing completed content to sit unpublished

* Build, update and troubleshoot landing pages, service pages and other website sections

* Perform website QA before and after launches and major updates

* Troubleshoot Elementor display conditions, responsive issues, forms, navigation, templates and other front-end problems

* Coordinate website changes with developers when development support is required

* Review developer work instead of assuming that a completed ticket means the work was completed correctly

* Clearly document bugs, screenshots, expected behavior and required fixes when escalating development issues



SEO & Local Search



You will also support our organic search work across multiple client accounts, including:



* Conduct detailed on-page SEO reviews

* Perform Google Business Profile audits

* Identify inconsistencies or missed optimization opportunities across client websites and local profiles

* Review Google Search Console for indexing, performance and technical issues

* Help identify why rankings, traffic or visibility changed rather than simply reporting that they changed

* Review existing content performance and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded or reformatted

* Help optimize content for both traditional search engines and AI-driven search experiences

* Support internal linking strategies and entity relationships across client websites

* Research competitors when needed to understand why they may be outperforming a client

* Flag technical, content or authority issues before they become larger problems



Schema & Structured Data



Structured data is an important part of our SEO process.



You will:



* Complete and review schema intake information

* Help implement and QA advanced JSON-LD schema

* Understand connected schema entities rather than treating schema as isolated markup

* Review Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, Person, ProfilePage, WebSite, WebPage and related schema

* Test implementation using schema validation tools

* Identify incorrect, incomplete or conflicting schema

* Coordinate with developers when schema implementation requires development support

* Verify the final implementation rather than considering a task complete simply because code was added



You do not need to be the world's foremost schema expert on day one, but you must be technically curious and capable of learning advanced implementation quickly.



Website Ownership



One of the biggest things we need from this position is ownership.



When you are responsible for a website task, we expect you to follow it through to completion.



That means:



* confirming requirements before work begins

* identifying missing information early

* completing what you can independently

* escalating true blockers quickly

* following up on delegated development work

* testing the completed work

* documenting what changed

* confirming the task actually solved the original problem



You should not require a manager to repeatedly check whether something was completed, remind you of the deadline or discover that a task was only partially finished.



Think, Don't Just Execute



We are specifically looking for someone with professional judgment.



If you're given a task and notice something else is wrong, say something.



If instructions conflict with what you see on the website, investigate.



If a developer's solution doesn't make sense, question it.



If an SEO recommendation could hurt the client, don't blindly implement it.



If you aren't sure whether something is technically correct, research it and come back with a recommendation.



We would rather hear:



“I investigated this and recommend Option B because…”



than receive ten questions that could have been answered through reasonable research and professional judgment.



Internal AI & Automation



We want this person to become one of Elevation Marketing's internal **AI power users**.



You will help us:



* stay current on meaningful developments in AI, search and marketing technology

* identify AI tools or workflows that could improve efficiency or client results

* help create and maintain custom GPTs and internal AI tools

* improve prompts and workflows used by our team

* research new capabilities and determine whether they are genuinely useful or simply hype

* help document repeatable AI-assisted processes

* find opportunities to automate repetitive work without sacrificing quality or judgment



We're not looking for someone who uses AI to replace thinking.



We're looking for someone who uses AI to think and execute better.



Project & Team Support



You will work closely with our project-management and SEO teams and help keep execution moving.



This includes:



* maintaining clear updates in ClickUp

* reviewing assigned tasks and understanding the desired outcome before beginning

* raising blockers early rather than at the deadline

* communicating clearly with project managers, writers, designers and developers

* documenting work completed and next steps

* helping Josefina keep website and SEO projects moving forward

* recognizing when you can solve something yourself versus when it genuinely needs to be escalated



ClickUp experience is preferred but not required. We can teach the platform.



We cannot teach ownership, curiosity or professional judgment.



What We're Looking For



Must Have



* 4+ years of hands-on SEO and/or website-management experience

* Strong WordPress experience

* Strong Elementor experience

* Experience working with **WP Engine**

* Strong on-page SEO knowledge

* Technical SEO troubleshooting ability

* Experience managing or maintaining multiple websites

* Experience with Google Search Console

* Familiarity with GA4

* Working knowledge of Google Business Profiles and Local SEO

* Experience implementing or reviewing schema / structured data

* Ability to troubleshoot website problems independently

* Strong written English communication

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to work U.S. business hours

* Experience working successfully with a remote team



Agency experience is strongly preferred.



Experience working with U.S. contractors, home services or local service businesses is a major plus.



Nice to Have



* ClickUp experience

* Advanced JSON-LD/schema experience

* Google Tag Manager experience

* Technical GA4/tracking troubleshooting

* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge

* Experience with Cloudflare

* Experience with Gravity Forms

* Experience with Rank Math

* Experience building custom GPTs or internal AI workflows

* Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs or Semrush

* Experience with website migrations and launches



Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is curious, resourceful and proactive.



You do not need permission to notice a problem.



You do not blindly check a box because a task says “complete.”

title: Tender & Bid Specialist — Australian Market
description:
We are an Australian-registered engineering and equipment supply company. We bid on Australian tenders — government, council, utility and private developer — for electrical and general equipment supply and engineering advisory work. We are a small, senior team. You will work directly with the Head of Procurement and own real bids from your first week.



THE ROLE

You will run our Australian tender pipeline end to end: find the tenders worth bidding, build the compliance documentation, get prices from suppliers around the world, calculate the delivered-to-site cost, and submit on time through the buyer's portal. Roughly half the work is documents and compliance; the other half is pricing — and the pricing half is the part we care most about.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Find and qualify

- Monitor daily opportunities and screen them against our capability rules; write a one-paragraph BID / NO-BID recommendation covering scope, licensing gates, closing date, insurance and turnover thresholds, and local-content requirements.

- Maintain the opportunity tracker (Google Sheets) — every tender, status, deadline, owner, outcome.



Build the bid

- Build a compliance matrix mapping every mandatory requirement to where it is answered. Nothing unanswered, ever.

- Maintain the reusable library: capability statements, company profile, referee/past-project sheets, WHS and quality responses, insurance certificates, conflict-of-interest and modern-slavery declarations.

- Complete the buyer's response schedules exactly as issued — correct templates, file names, format. Register and manage submissions in buyer portals; track addenda; lodge questions before cut-off.



Price the bid (most important)

- Issue RFQs to manufacturers and distributors in Australia, Europe and North America; chase written quotes with lead times and validity dates.

- Build the landed cost: ex-works, Incoterm, freight, insurance, duty, GST, port and clearance, local delivery, currency exposure, warranty and spares — then apply our margin rules.

- Produce the priced schedule of rates / bill of quantities in the buyer's format, with a clean, auditable cost model.

- Flag commercial risk: fixed-price exposure over long lead times, liquidated damages, payment terms, retention, and price-validity mismatches.



After submission

- Log every outcome; request and record debriefs on losses; keep a running list of winning prices where known.

- Keep our registrations current: panels, prequalification schemes, supplier portals, ICN.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 4+ years in bid/tender, estimating, quotation or procurement — ideally for an electrical, industrial, engineering or construction supply business.

- Demonstrable experience preparing bids for Australian buyers, or another Western public-procurement market.

- Excellent written English. Ferocious attention to deadlines and detail — a missing signature or a late submission is an automatic zero.

- Reliable internet, own computer, and availability 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PHT.

Bonus Points For

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role
