title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets.



We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains.



This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction.



Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy.



What You'll Do

Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic.

Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet.

Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions.

Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics.

Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost.

GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search.

Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results.

Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does.



How You'll Operate

You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute.

Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results.

You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes.

If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving.



How We'll Measure Success

The primary scorecard starts with high-quality referring domains, links, brand mentions, and citations acquired.

Quality and relevance of referring domains

Number and diversity of links acquired

Brand mentions and AI/answer-engine citations

Growth and quality of our backlink profiles

Cost and value of paid acquisitions

Performance of different campaigns and tactics

The goal is improved rankings, search visibility, and organic traffic.

We'll have lightweight weekly and monthly reporting, and you'll maintain enough structured tracking for us to understand which sources, tactics, and campaigns are producing the best results.



What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it.

Acquire high-quality backlinks through multiple strategies - not just paid placements or mass outreach.

Evaluate whether a backlink opportunity is genuinely valuable using data and judgment.

Develop and execute creative link-building campaigns from idea through acquisition.

Conduct effective outreach to journalists, bloggers, publishers, website owners, and partners.

Evaluate and negotiate paid placements rather than simply accepting quoted prices.

Use competitive backlink analysis, reclamation, prospecting, and other core off-page SEO techniques.

Understand GEO/AEO and the growing importance of off-site brand mentions and citations.

Use AI to dramatically increase your research, prospecting, outreach, analysis, and execution capacity.

Run multiple campaigns independently and prioritize your time based on expected impact.

Communicate effectively in English internally and externally.

Know when to experiment, when to scale something that works, and when to stop wasting time on something that doesn't.

We don't care what industry you've worked in. We don't care whether you learned link building at an agency, in-house, independently, or somewhere else.

We care whether you can produce results.



Tools & Resources

Ahrefs

Google Search Console

SEO Gets

Claude company subscription

If another tool or resource will materially improve results, make the case for it.

The same applies to campaign and link-acquisition spend. We don't have a rigid price we're willing to pay for a link. Budget follows value. Find the opportunity, evaluate it intelligently, negotiate it well, and tell us why it's worth the investment.



The Role in One Sentence

Own off-page SEO across several domains, attack link acquisition from multiple angles, use AI and your own resourcefulness to execute at a high level, and be accountable for measurable results.

If that's already how you approach link building, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Phone Receptionist | Account Manager | Administrative Assistant

*Schedule:* Monday to Friday, U.S. Eastern business hours (night shift PH time)

*Pay:* $4 to $7/hour USD depending on role and experience

This is a hybrid position combining phone receptionist duties, account management, and administrative support. It is not a basic data-entry role. We are looking for someone who is conscientious, proactive, follows through without constant reminders, communicates professionally, and keeps accurate records so that nothing falls through the cracks.

1. Phone Receptionist

First, you will have to learn about what we do, who we service, and enough to engage intellectually with any prospective client. * Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally

s and make return calls when necessary

* Make outbound follow-up calls for missing information, documents, appointments, or account updates

* Remain calm and professional when dealing with confused, frustrated, or upset callers

* Avoid guessing or giving unauthorized legal, financial, or credit advice

* Escalate urgent or sensitive matters to management promptly

* Initially, we would require you to log every call into our CRM.

*Best fit:* 2+ years answering U.S. phone lines for a law office, collection agency or debt settlement company, or BPO. Clear, confident spoken English.



2. Account Manager

* Manage assigned client accounts from onboarding through completion or resolution

* Maintain an accurate status, next action, and deadline for every assigned account

* Follow up with clients regarding missing documents, information, signatures, payments, or other outstanding requirements

* Review applications and supporting documents for completeness and obvious inconsistencies

* Organize bank statements, credit reports, paystubs, tax documents, contracts, correspondence, and other records when applicable

* Flag missing, conflicting, or unusual information for management review

* Communicate account status clearly and professionally to clients

* Coordinate with internal team members and outside parties

* Record every important call,
, promise, deadline, and follow-up

* Prepare account summaries, progress reports, and lists of overdue action items

* Escalate accounts that are delayed, disputed, high-risk, or approaching a deadline

* Maintain client relationships while still being persistent about required information and next steps

Experience with reviewing and completing financial documents is a bonus.

*Best fit:* 2+ years in U.S. consumer collections, credit repair, debt settlement, bankruptcy support, or bank credit work reviewing applications and financials.



3. Administrative Assistant

Help keep the office running behind the scenes. 

* Manage and organize
 communications

* Maintain calendars and schedule meetings

* Perform accurate data entry and CRM updates

* Create and maintain spreadsheets, reports, and tracking lists

* Prepare routine letters,
s, forms, and internal documents

* Organize digital files using consistent naming and folder systems

* Monitor outstanding tasks and follow up with the responsible person

* Assist with invoicing, payment tracking, or account reconciliation when assigned

* Conduct basic online research

* Maintain templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures

* Support management with other administrative and operational assignments

* Identify recurring problems and suggest practical improvements

*Best fit:* 2+ years in administrative, legal support, or back-office BPO work. Strong written English and sharp attention to detail.



Requirements for All Roles

* At least two years of relevant professional experience

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, professional, and easily understood phone communication

* Experience communicating with U.S.-based clients or companies

* Strong listening, note-taking, and organizational skills

* High attention to detail and comfort working with numbers and financial documents

* Ability to manage several accounts and deadlines simultaneously

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Comfortable following detailed procedures and checklists

* Professional judgment when handling confidential information

* Comfortable receiving feedback, training, and performance expectations

* Fully available and responsive throughout the scheduled U.S. business-hours shift

* Reliable computer, quality headset, and quiet professional workspace

* Stable high-speed internet connection

* Backup internet and backup power strongly preferred

* Willingness to sign a confidentiality or nondisclosure agreement

* Quick to learn new phone systems and CRMs (we primarily use 
, DropBox, Adobe, Electronic document and PDF-management systems, Microsoft Word and Excel, Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar, Internet-based phone or VOIP systems, QuickBooks)



Candidates with experience in any of the following industries are strongly encouraged to apply:

* Banking, credit analysis, underwriting support, or loan processing

* Reviewing applications, bank statements, credit reports, or other financial documents

* U.S. credit-repair companies

* U.S. bankruptcy firms or other law firms

* Consumer or commercial collections

* Accounts receivable, payment recovery, or debt settlement

* Financial services, insurance, mortgage servicing, or claims follow-up

* U.S.-based customer service, account management, or call-center operations



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Calls are answered professionally and documented accurately

* Every account has a clear status, next action, and deadline

* Missing documents and unanswered requests are followed up on promptly

* Client questions are acknowledged and routed correctly

* Management can understand the status of an account without searching through multiple systems

* Records remain organized, complete, and current

* Important deadlines are identified early rather than after they are missed

* Clients receive professional, consistent communication

* Confidential information is handled carefully and securely



How to Apply

Provide us with:

2. A 1-2 minute voice/video recording introducing yourself and your relevant experience, and anything else you believe is relevant

   • Account management or case coordination

   • Administrative support

4. The industries in which you have worked

6. A list of the CRM, phone, legal, credit-repair, collection, and administrative systems you have used

7. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation in U.S. Dollars.

title: Real Estate VA- Operations- Monday.com
description:
Sarway Group is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help run the day-to-day operating system behind a high-performing luxury real estate team.



This is not a traditional administrative VA role. You will help manage the systems, workflows, team accountability, CRM hygiene, marketing operations, and follow-up processes that keep the business running.



The ideal candidate is extremely comfortable with technology, takes ownership without being chased, notices when things are falling through the cracks, and enjoys building order around a fast-moving team.



What You’ll Own




 / CRM Management



You will be responsible for keeping our 
 operating system clean and current, including:



Monitoring active buyers, sellers, landlords, renters, listings, transactions, and team tasks

Making sure every active opportunity has the correct stage, owner, priority, next action, and due date

Catching missing or outdated information before it becomes a problem

Maintaining contact records and CRM data hygiene

Reviewing dashboards and queues daily

Identifying overdue follow-ups and incomplete tasks

Making sure closed, inactive, and active opportunities are properly categorized

Troubleshooting simple 
 workflows and escalating system issues when necessary



Team Operations



You will help make sure everyone on the team knows what they are responsible for and that work gets completed.



This includes:



Reviewing team responsibilities each morning

Following up on overdue or incomplete tasks

Assigning and routing operational work

Making sure tasks have clear owners and deadlines

Preparing items that require Abraham's attention

Keeping team members accountable without requiring Abraham to personally chase every task

Maintaining SOPs and documenting new processes

Helping onboard new team members into our systems



Pipeline & Follow-Up Control



A major responsibility of this role is ensuring that no client, deal, listing, or opportunity disappears because someone forgot to follow up.



You will:



Review upcoming and overdue next actions

Flag high-priority clients and transactions

Make sure agents update their pipeline

Confirm follow-ups are actually completed

Maintain clean records of completed actions

Surface anything requiring immediate attention



Your job is not necessarily to personally communicate with every client. Your job is to make sure the right person communicates with them at the right time.



Listing & Transaction Operations



You will help coordinate operational tasks associated with listings and transactions, including:



Tracking listing stages and required next steps

Coordinating photography, floor plans, marketing materials, launch preparation, open houses, and listing updates

Monitoring contract and closing milestones

Making sure required tasks are generated and completed at each stage

Keeping listing and transaction information organized across systems

Coordinating with team members, vendors, and outside parties where appropriate



You will not be expected to negotiate deals or replace the agents. Your role is to make sure the operational machine behind the deal works.



Marketing Operations



You will coordinate with our marketing team to make sure marketing requests move from idea → assignment → completion.



This may include:



Routing listing marketing requests

Tracking social media and content deliverables

Coordinating
 campaigns

Monitoring marketing deadlines

Organizing listing assets

Making sure marketing projects have owners, deadlines, and completed deliverables



You do not need to be the graphic designer, copywriter, or social media creator. You need to make sure those people actually get what they need and deliver on time.



Data & Reporting



You will help maintain accurate business information and prepare simple operating reports, including:



Pipeline activity

Overdue follow-ups

Active opportunities

Listing activity

Team task completion

Marketing activity

CRM cleanliness

Potential revenue / pipeline value



You should be able to look at the system and tell the team leader:



What needs attention today?

What is late?

What is at risk?

What is missing?

Who owns the next action?



Tools We Use



Experience with 
 is highly preferred.



Our technology stack includes platforms such as:





Google Workspace

Gmail

Google Sheets

Google Drive

ActiveCampaign

Canva

DocuSign

Zapier / Make

Slack

Real estate listing and CRM platforms



You do not need to know every tool on day one, but you must be extremely comfortable learning software quickly.



Who Will Excel in This Role



You are likely a strong fit if you:



Are extremely organized

Naturally notice missing information

Love systems, processes, and checklists

Are comfortable holding people accountable

Can follow an SOP but also recognize when something does not make sense

Take initiative rather than waiting for instructions

Communicate clearly and concisely

Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Can manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed

Treat confidential client information with discretion

Have strong written English

Are comfortable working directly with a demanding founder/team leader

Prefer responsibility and ownership over repetitive data-entry work

What We Do NOT Want



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.



This role will not work for someone who:



Needs constant supervision

Is afraid to follow up with team members

Leaves incomplete records in the CRM

Checks boxes without understanding the purpose of the work

Says “I didn't know” instead of investigating

Lets overdue work sit without escalating it

Is uncomfortable learning new technology

What Success Looks Like



Within the first few months, the goal is for the team leader to be able to open the operating system each morning and trust that:



The CRM is accurate

Every important opportunity has a next action

Overdue work has been identified

Team members know what they need to do

Marketing projects are moving

Listings and transactions are progressing

Important information is not buried

Problems are surfaced before they become emergencies



Ultimately, your job is to help create a business where the system runs the team instead of the team leader having to remember everything.

description:
Freelance Creator Sourcing Specialist (TikTok & Instagram)

Role Type: Contractor 

Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and chronically online Creator Sourcing Specialist to help us identify short-form video creators for our growing ambassador program. Your singular focus will be discovery and lead generation.

You will not be responsible for DMing,
ing, or negotiating with these creators. Your job is strictly to find the right talent, vet their metrics, and hand off a high-quality list to our outreach team. IMPORTANT: WE HAVE A STRICT QUOTA OF HOW MANY INFLUENCERS WE EXPECT PER WEEK. ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE ABLE TO FIND AT LEAST 500 INFLUENCERS WEEK VIA TIKTOK/INSTAGRAM APP. 

What You’ll Do

Deep-Dive Sourcing: Scour TikTok and Instagram to find short-form creators who align with our target demographics (specifically micro-influencers, sports tipsters, and engaging niche commentators).

Market Focus: Identify creators who specifically resonate with Latin American audiences and produce content in Spanish.

What We’re Looking For

Platform Expertise: You know the ins and outs of TikTok and Instagram algorithms, hashtags, and discovery tools.

Analytical Eye: You understand that a high follower count doesn't always equal high engagement, and you know how to spot authentic communities.

Detail-Oriented: You take pride in building clean, accurate, and easy-to-read spreadsheets.

Cultural Fluency: Familiarity with LatAm digital culture and fluency in Spanish is highly preferred to effectively evaluate the creators' content.

Self-Starter: You can take a creator brief and run with it, delivering lists on time with minimal micromanagement.



How to Apply

Please send a brief introduction about your experience with social media research, along with a quick list of 3 TikTok or Instagram creators (handles only) that you think are currently producing highly engaging, sports or tech-adjacent short-form content for LatAm audiences. Also check out our website 
 for more information.

title: Experienced Auto Glass Sales Representative – Remote | Base + Commission
description:
Experienced Auto Glass Sales Representative – Remote | Base + Commission



Hunt Glass is hiring an experienced Sales Representative in the Philippines to handle inbound and outbound sales for our growing U.S.-based auto glass company.



This is primarily a SALES position.



We are looking for an exceptional salesperson—not simply a customer service representative. You should be highly confident on the phone, persuasive without being pushy, excellent at building trust, and motivated by closing sales and earning commissions.



At the same time, you must be extremely organized. You will be managing many customers at different stages of the sales cycle, following up consistently, keeping accurate notes, scheduling jobs, and making sure valuable leads do not fall through the cracks.



Compensation



Target Total Earnings: $7–$14+ USD/hour



Base Pay: $3.00 USD/hour

Plus Commission



There is significant opportunity to earn more through excellent sales performance. We want someone who is motivated by results and wants their income to grow as they help the company grow.



What You'll Do



Inbound Sales



- Answer incoming calls, texts, and online leads

- Quickly build rapport and trust with potential customers

- Understand the customer's needs and recommend the appropriate auto glass service

- Provide quotes and confidently ask for the sale

- Overcome objections professionally

- Convert inquiries and quotes into scheduled appointments

- Follow up consistently with customers who have not yet scheduled



Outbound Sales



- Call and follow up with existing leads and previous inquiries

- Re-engage customers who received quotes but did not schedule

- Conduct outbound sales and prospecting as assigned, i.e. to fleets and dealerships

- Develop relationships with potential customers and business accounts

- Consistently work toward sales and conversion goals



Sales Cycle & Customer Management



You may be communicating with many different customers at the same time, each at a different stage of the sales process.



You must be able to:



- Keep detailed, accurate customer notes

- Know exactly where each customer is in the sales cycle

- Follow up at the appropriate time

- Keep leads organized and prioritized

- Coordinate appointments and scheduling

- Communicate clearly with customers and our operations team

- Make sure leads do not get forgotten

- Follow a structured sales process consistently



Being organized is extremely important for this position.



Required Qualifications



Exceptional Sales Ability



You MUST have significant experience with both inbound AND outbound sales.



We are specifically looking for candidates with a proven track record of exceptional sales results.



Our ideal candidate has performed among the top sales representatives on their previous teams, i.e. in the top 5%.



We want someone who:



- Loves selling

- Is comfortable asking for the sale

- Knows how to overcome objections

- Builds rapport quickly

- Understands consultative selling

- Follows up consistently

- Is competitive and motivated by measurable results

- Can explain their previous sales numbers and achievements



Exceptional People Skills



You must genuinely love talking with people all day.



This position involves spending a large part of your day on the phone with customers, leads, and business contacts. We are looking for someone who gets energy from talking with people—not someone who simply tolerates phone calls because they are part of the job.



You should be the kind of person who:



- Genuinely enjoys meeting and talking with new people

- Builds rapport very quickly

- Is naturally warm, friendly, confident, and engaging

- Makes customers feel comfortable and listened to

- Can easily carry a conversation without sounding scripted

- Enjoys learning about people and understanding what they need

- Can connect naturally with many different personalities

- Leaves people feeling good after speaking with you



You should love talking with people—and people should love talking with you.



Excellent sales techniques are important, but we are looking for someone who combines those skills with exceptional natural people skills. We want customers to feel like they are talking with a knowledgeable, helpful person they trust—not someone reading from a sales script.



Exceptional English



Your spoken English must be exceptional—approximately top 5% proficiency among Filipino applicants working with U.S. customers.



You should:



- Speak English fluently and naturally

- Be very easy for U.S. customers to understand

- Have excellent listening comprehension

- Communicate confidently over the phone

- Write professional texts,
s, and customer notes

- Be comfortable having unscripted conversations with American customers



Excellent Organization



You must have experience managing a large number of customers, leads, or opportunities simultaneously.



You should be comfortable working inside CRM, scheduling, or sales-management software and maintaining accurate records throughout the sales process.



We are looking for someone who can keep many conversations moving forward at once without losing track of details, follow-ups, quotes, appointments, or next steps.



DEFINITE PLUS but not required: Auto Glass / Omega EDI Experience



Please tell us specifically if you have experience with:



- Omega EDI

- Auto glass sales

- Windshield replacement quoting

- Insurance glass claims

- Auto glass scheduling

- Working with insurance companies

- Auto glass parts or glass ordering



Omega EDI experience is NOT required.



We are willing to train the right person on auto glass and our software if they already have exceptional sales ability, English proficiency, people skills, and organizational skills.



Who We Are Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who can honestly say:



“I know how to sell. I have the numbers to prove it. I love talking with people, people enjoy talking with me, I am excellent on the phone, I am extremely organized, and I know how to turn leads into customers.”



If that describes you, we want to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your inbound sales experience.

2. Describe your outbound sales experience.

3. What products or services have you sold?

4. What were your sales goals or KPIs?

5. What were your actual results?

6. Where did you rank compared with other sales representatives on your team?

7. Give us an example of a sales achievement you are especially proud of.

8. Describe how you kept a large number of leads/customers organized and made sure you followed up with them.

9. Do you genuinely enjoy spending most of your workday talking with people? Tell us why.

10. Have you worked with U.S. customers?

11. Do you have any auto glass experience?

12. Have you ever used Omega EDI? If yes, please describe exactly what you did with it.

13. Please provide a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are an exceptional salesperson.



Important: Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for measurable evidence of excellent sales performance.



We are looking for a long-term team member who wants to grow with Hunt Glass and be rewarded for producing excellent results.

title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator — HighLevel Experience Required
description:
# Social Media Manager & Content Creator — HighLevel Experience Required



**Ongoing Part-Time Position | Long-Term Opportunity**



I own a growing marketing agency and am looking for a creative, reliable **Social Media Manager and Content Creator** who can help create, organize, and publish content for our agency and potentially some of our clients.



I'm looking for someone who can do more than simply schedule posts.



You should be able to take a business, understand its audience, research what they should be talking about, and turn those ideas into **professional graphics, engaging written content, and a consistent social media presence.**



## What You'll Be Doing



* Research and develop social media content ideas

* Write engaging captions and social media posts

* Create professional branded graphics in Canva

* Create carousels, educational graphics, promotional posts, quote graphics, etc.

* Repurpose existing videos, blogs, websites, and other material into social content

* Create simple reels and short-form video content when needed

* Develop monthly content calendars

* Schedule and publish content using **HighLevel Social Planner**

* Adapt content for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile and other platforms

* Help maintain consistent branding and messaging

* Occasionally create content for marketing agency clients

* Review scheduled content for accuracy before publishing



## HighLevel Experience Is Required



You should already have experience working inside **GoHighLevel / HighLevel**.



In particular, I want someone who is comfortable using:



* HighLevel Social Planner

* Scheduling posts across multiple platforms

* Managing social accounts inside different HighLevel sub-accounts

* Working inside a marketing agency environment



Please do not apply if you have never worked inside HighLevel.



## What I'm Looking For



I don't want to have to provide every caption and tell you exactly what graphic to create.



I want to be able to give you a business, website, topic, video, or general idea and have you turn it into great content.



For example, I should be able to say:



**"Here is this client's website. Research their business and give me 10 strong content ideas for next month."**



And you should be able to take it from there.



You should be:



* Creative

* Organized

* Dependable

* A strong English writer

* Excellent with Canva or similar design tools

* Comfortable creating content from scratch

* Able to research unfamiliar industries

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity

* Able to create content that doesn't sound obviously AI-generated

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at following brand guidelines



## Tools We Use



Experience with these is preferred:



* **HighLevel / GoHighLevel**

* **HighLevel Social Planner**

* Canva

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Google Drive / Docs / Sheets

* CapCut or similar video editing software

*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* Google Business Profile



## Hours



This will begin as a **part-time ongoing position**, with the potential for additional hours and responsibilities.



I'm looking for someone interested in a **long-term working relationship**, not just a short project.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Examples of social media accounts you've managed.

3. 3–5 graphics you've personally created.

4. Examples of captions/content you've personally written.

5. Describe your experience using **HighLevel Social Planner**.

6. Tell me how you use AI when creating social media content.

7. Your hourly rate.

8. Your weekly availability.



**IMPORTANT: Start your proposal with the words "SOCIAL PLANNER" so I know you read the entire posting.**



Finally, tell me:



**If I gave you a website for a local business and asked you to create a month of content, what would your process be?**

title: Executive Assistant (virtual) for Non Profit in Chicago
description:
Before you read: 

- Please do not send an automatically generated AI reply. Please read the text and respond in your own words, it will make your application stand out.  

- Please confirm if you are able to work in CST time (chicago central time) with at least 80% overlap from 9-5 CST. 



Your Mission

Your mission is to help the Executive Director stay focused on the organization’s highest priorities by creating structure, follow-through, and accountability around his time, relationships, projects, deadlines, and commitments.

This is not a traditional administrative role. You will help turn ideas into action, make sure important opportunities and relationships do not fall through the cracks, and help Rebels for Peace operate in a more organized and proactive way.



What You’ll Do

Executive Support & Priorities

Manage the Executive Director’s calendar, meetings,
 priorities, commitments, and follow-up.

Help organize weekly priorities and protect time for fundraising, partnerships, programs, leadership, and other high-value work.

Prepare the Executive Director for important meetings and events with relevant background, talking points, materials, and clear next steps.

Track decisions, commitments, and action items and make sure they are completed.

Help maintain a consistent newsletter and organizational communication schedule.

Gather stories, photos, program updates, accomplishments, and other content from across the organization.



Relationships, Fundraising & Opportunities

Maintain organized follow-up with donors, funders, partners, schools, community leaders, businesses, and other stakeholders.

Manage relationship information and next steps in the CRM and help create consistent stewardship rather than only reaching out when something is needed.

Research potential funders, partners, sponsors, conferences, community events, networking opportunities, and other opportunities that could benefit Rebels for Peace.

Help prepare outreach, presentations, sponsorship materials, newsletters, and other communications that support fundraising and relationship development.



Project & Event Management

Project manage events, fundraising campaigns, special initiatives, and Executive Director priorities from planning through completion.

Create clear timelines, responsibilities, deadlines, and milestones and coordinate staff, vendors, partners, and other stakeholders.

Identify potential delays or missing pieces early and make sure projects continue moving forward.

Build repeatable checklists, templates, and systems that make future events and campaigns easier to execute.

Operations, Reporting & Compliance

Maintain a master calendar for organizational deadlines, reports, renewals, contracts, filings, and other important requirements.

Gather information and documentation needed for reports, filings, board materials, and organizational records.

Maintain organized systems so important documents, deadlines, and responsibilities are easy to find and track.



Budgeting, Financial & Presentation Support

Assist with program, event, campaign, and organizational budgets and help track spending against budget.

Work with leadership and accounting support to organize financial information, invoices, receipts, reimbursements, and reporting.

Create spreadsheets, financial summaries, presentations, briefing documents, and other materials used for leadership, board, donor, and partner meetings.

Turn information and data into clear, professional, easy-to-understand materials.



Qualifications

We are looking for someone who is:

Exceptionally organized, proactive, and strong at follow-through.

A strong project manager who can take an idea, build a plan, and drive it to completion.

Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

A strong communicator who can professionally interact with donors, executives, board members, funders, partners, staff, and community stakeholders.

Comfortable working with budgets, spreadsheets, financial information, and basic accounting concepts.

Strong with Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Notion or similar tools.

Comfortable with CRMs, calendars,
, shared drives, project management tools, and other digital systems.

Able to work independently, exercise good judgment, and respectfully hold others accountable.

Professional, discreet, resourceful, and comfortable working with confidential information.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred: executive assistance, project management, nonprofit operations, fundraising, donor stewardship, events, budgeting, reporting, compliance, partnerships, or community engagement.



The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who notices what needs to happen and takes ownership of making it happen.

You enjoy creating order, managing details, building relationships, solving problems, and helping a busy leader stay focused.

You can move between coordinating an event, preparing a presentation, tracking a filing deadline, updating a budget, researching a potential partner, and making sure an important follow-up gets completed.

You turn priorities into plans, plans into action, and make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



About Rebels for Peace

Rebels for Peace is a Chicago-based nonprofit working with youth and communities impacted by gun violence. Through mentorship, social-emotional learning, leadership development, and community engagement, we help young people build the skills and relationships they need to choose peace and become leaders in their communities.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and relationship-oriented Executive Assistant & Relationship Coordinator to work closely with our Executive Director, Prince Jimmar.

Niche Familiarity: Comfort working with sports, tech, or gaming commentators, understanding standard rates and expectations for micro-influencers in these spaces.

Highly Organized: Exceptional ability to manage multiple overlapping negotiations, keep CRM/tracking sheets perfectly updated, and herd cats when creators miss posting deadlines.

Tactful Communication: The ability to be firm on contract terms and deliverables while maintaining a positive, relationship-building tone with talent.

title: Remote Receptionist VA (Quick Hire)

title: Video Editor - Church and Ministries Video
description:
Faith Culture. Purpose-Driven. Growth-Oriented.



**About Ruah Creative House**



Ruah Creative House is a remote, faith-driven creative studio helping churches, Christian nonprofits, and values aligned leaders communicate with clarity and excellence. We produce reels and sermon cuts, podcasts, event promos, bumpers, and social content designed for real impact, not vanity metrics.



**What we’re about**



- **Purpose over hype:** helpful, truthful, on mission storytelling.  

- **Craft and systems:** solid editing fundamentals, clean organization, reliable handoffs. We give you everything you need to do your job well.  

- **Teamwork:** clear briefs, quick feedback, zero drama. We grow people, not just projects.



**Who we serve**



- Multisite churches and ministries  

- Faith based coaches, entrepreneurs, and communicators  

- Community nonprofits and events  



**The Team You’ll Join**



You won’t be a lone editor on an island. We have a Creative Director setting the vision, a QA specialist reviewing work, a graphic designer, and a project manager keeping deadlines honest. We have a small team of 9 that you would make a great addition in! You’ll receive real briefs, real feedback, and people who care whether your work is good.



**Why join our team**



- Consistent, faith aligned work  

- A kind team that invests in training and tools  

- Clear deadlines, realistic scopes, and room to grow  

- Flexible atmosphere

- Paid PH holidays plus your birthday off; bonuses for urgent or weekend sprints when offered 

- Paid time off - Holidays and Sick time

- 13th Month Pay

- Direct training and 1:1 Meetings with Owner



**Role at a Glance**



- **Title:** Video Editing Specialist (Full Time)  

- **Compensation:** Starting $600/month USD, paid bi weekly via Wise  

- **Hours:** 40 hrs/week, fully remote  

- **Reports to:** Eric Munoz (Owner), Alberto Cordero (Creative Director - PH). Your work is also reviewed by our Creative Content QA Specialist before it reaches clients.  

- **Probation:** Paid 2 week training period with one month probation, converting to full-time benefits on successful completion  

- **Schedule:** Light flexibility, keep your deadlines. One mandatory weekly tea
eting, Mondays at 9 AM PHT.  



**What You’ll Make**



You’ll edit short form and long form projects for faith based organizations and purpose?led clients:



- Sermon Reels (short, social first clips)  

- Sermon Cuts (longer excerpts for YouTube and web)  

- Podcasts (video first, simple edits)  

- Bumpers and Openers (series and welcome intros)  

- Event Promos and Event Recaps  

- Coach and small business content (training, VSLs, social)  



On output: this is a full time seat, so we think in terms of a full day’s work rather than a quota. Volume shifts with complexity. Some days that’s a handful of simple to moderate reels; other days it’s one larger edit that takes your whole block. We’ll set expectations per project in the brief.



**What You’ll Do**



- Edit short form and long form video in Adobe Premiere Pro  

- Apply clean motion basics: pacing, captions, light effects, tasteful transitions  

- Source music and B roll from licensed libraries (we provide the subscriptions)  

- Follow project briefs closely and keep style and tone aligned to each client  

- Own your queue in Motion, our project?management tool: your tasks, your deadlines, your handoffs  

- Upload exports, organize folders, archive projects properly  

- Work with QA for quick, accurate revisions  

- Communicate proactively in Chat and Motion comments  



**What Great Looks Like**



- On time delivery against clear deadlines  

- Accurate spelling and graphics, strong hooks, clean color and audio  

- Organized projects any teammate can pick up  

- You raise risks early, suggest solutions, and keep 
ntum without being chased  



**Requirements**



- **Editing:** Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe CC proficiency ONLY, strong English comprehension  

- **Internet:** Reliable connection, 50?Mbps down / 20 Mbps up minimum, plus a backup hotspot  

- **Hardware:** Apple Silicon or i7/Ryzen?7, 16 GB+ RAM, SSD storage (2TB total working space recommended), dedicated GPU preferred  

- **Workflow:** Comfortable with Google Drive, Motion (we train you), Loom and 
 for reviews  

- **Communication:** Daily check in and check out message, responsive in Chat during your work block, respectful of faith friendly content  



**Nice to Have**



- After Effects fundamentals (lower thirds, simple animations)  

- Ministry or church media experience 

- Videography understanding

- Color grading experience



**How to Apply**



 subject: *Ruah Creative House EDITOR, Your Name, Your Favorite Color*



Include:



1. Three links to your strongest social first edits (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, YouTube)  

2. A speed-test screenshot 

3. One or two sentences: something you love about editing, and one area you want to improve  

4. A short paragraph about a time you handled a project responsibly with minimal supervision. How did you keep it on track and who did you tell when something slipped?  

5. Confirm and share either A. Personal Faith story and church experience (if any). OR B. open to working in a faith driven work culture and faith based clients



Follow the steps in order. We pay attention to detail here, and we notice when you do too.



**Process & Timeline**



- We review applications as they come in  

- Shortlist, then a possible short paid test, then an interview, then an offer  

- Onboarding: paid 2 week on ramp training - 1 month probation  



**Ground Rules**



To protect the team and our clients, we can’t move forward if you:

title: Virtual Assistant – Music Campaign Coordination
description:
Producer Labs is a Los Angeles-based music marketing agency.



We're looking for a Campaign Coordinator to support two campaign managers. A label hands us a song and a budget — you're the one who turns that into booked creators, collected drafts, and posts going live on schedule.



Shift: This is a graveyard-shift role. You'll need to be online and reachable 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time (roughly 1:00 AM–9:00 AM Philippine time). Please only apply if you can commit to this schedule long-term.



How it works: Brands and labels bring us a budget and a track. We allocate that budget across creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube who post with the song. We don't manage creators directly — we build relationships and deploy them on campaigns. You'll be at the center of that, in daily contact with creators.



We're a small, fast-moving team, and this role's scope will grow with the company. It's a good fit for someone who wants increasing responsibility over time, jumps into new problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions, and sees a growing plate as a sign of trust, not a burden.



What you'll do



Build and vet creator lists for active campaigns, and help shape the proposal that goes back to the client

Handle creator outreach and negotiation via DM and
 — pitch, settle on a rate, lock in the booking

Track down drafts and posts: get ETAs, check content against the brief, follow up until it's live

Replace creators who go dark or drop out, and fill the slot before the deadline slips

Keep 15–20 active campaigns updated in Airtable so status is visible to anyone on the team

Flag stalled campaigns early, along with what's already been tried and what's needed to unblock it



Must-haves



2+ years in campaign support, coordination, or a VA role with substantial outreach experience

Strong written English — you'll be pitching creators and sitting in on client conversations

Comfortable on video calls, and comfortable being the one to speak up when something's off track

Able to juggle multiple campaigns without letting follow-ups slip

Can commit long-term to the graveyard shift

Reliable power and internet, with a backup plan in place for outages



Nice-to-haves



Experience in music marketing, influencer marketing, or the creator economy

Deck-building skills (Gamma, Canva, or Google Slides)

Familiarity with Airtable, 
, or Slack



To apply: Send us one real outreach message you've sent to a creator or partner, and tell us what happened afterward. Shortlisted candidates will receive a short form, followed by a 20-minute video interview.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About the Role 



Reports to: Founder / Chief Revenue Officer 



Our client is a fast-growing luxury short-term rental (STR) business based in Austin, Texas, with an ambitious goal: to become one of the largest luxury property management companies in the United States.



We're looking for an Operations Lead who shares that ambition—an A-player who can spearhead virtual operations, triage existing vendor relationships, and help find and build new vendor partnerships across the home trade sector. Given the nature of the business, this role requires acting with urgency on every issue, big or small, and resolving problems before they become guest-facing.



The company currently manages 9 luxury properties and is on an aggressive growth trajectory, with plans to scale to 20+ properties by the end of 2026. The portfolio is currently trending toward approximately $100,000 per month in gross rental revenue and operates within a premium hospitality environment where consistency, organization, and operational excellence are essential.



As the portfolio continues to expand, the company is focused on building the systems, processes, and infrastructure needed to support growth while maintaining a consistently high standard of guest experience and property operations. The business moves fast, with multiple properties, vendors, team members, and operational moving parts that must work together seamlessly.



This is not a caretaker role. We're looking for an Operations Lead who can bring structure, consistency, and scalability to a growing luxury hospitality operation—someone who is energized by ambitious goals, enjoys creating order, improving processes, and helping build the operational foundation required to support rapid growth.



As the company grows from its current 9-property portfolio toward 20+ properties and beyond, the Operations Lead will have the opportunity to grow alongside the business and take on increasing ownership as the organization scales. 



What You’ll Own 



Systems & SOP Development (Primary Focus)  



• Process Documentation: Turn task notes into clean, usable SOPs and checklists for guest experience and property ops.  

• Optimization: Identify inefficiencies and proactively recommend workflow improvements.  

• Tracking: Build and maintain simple systems (vendor trackers, maintenance logs, escalation dashboards).  

• AI Integration: Support the implementation of AI-assisted workflows and operational automation.  



 

Vendor Coordination & Property Operations  



• Scheduling: Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and specialty vendors (pool, landscaping, etc.).  

• New Vendor Development: Proactively identify, vet, and build relationships with new vendors across the home trade sector to expand our network as we scale.  

• Communication: Use text/email for efficiency; make phone calls to US vendors when speed is required.  

• Quality Control: Maintain vendor notes, pricing, and performance tracking.  

• Triage: Handle maintenance troubleshooting and ensure timely resolutions.  

• Responsiveness: Maintain 5–10 minute response SLAs during working hours, answer the phone at all times while on shift, and schedule vendor appointments promptly. 



 

Guest Operations & Tech Management  



• System Oversight: Manage AI messaging tools (Hospitable, HostBuddy) to ensure concierge-level service.  

• Escalations: Professionally handle high-risk guest situations and flag risks before they affect reviews.  

• Knowledge Base: Maintain property FAQs and internal reference guides.  



 

Admin & Financial Support  



• Daily Reporting: Send structured daily summaries highlighting progress and bottlenecks.  

• Finance: Support basic workflows, including vendor payments and expense tracking in QuickBooks.  

• Growth: Assist with CRM hygiene (GoHighLevel/Vintory) and market research.  

 

Who This Role Is For  



You may be a strong fit if you:  



• Are Ambitious: You want to build something big, and you're excited to grow with a company aiming to become the largest luxury property management business in the US.  

• Have STR Experience: You understand the fast-paced nature of property management. 

• Are a Systems Thinker: You have built or improved SOPs and workflows before.  

• Communicate Confidently: Exceptional spoken and written English; comfortable calling US vendors.  

• Are Comfortable on the Phone: Speaking with vendors, guests, and clients by phone is second nature to you, not something you avoid.  

• Operate with Urgency: You treat every issue, big or small, as time-sensitive, and you resolve problems before they escalate.  

• Are Proactive: You anticipate the needs of the business and leadership team before being asked, and use that foresight to help drive the business forward rather than just reacting to what's in front of you.  

• Are AI-Fluent: You use AI tools beyond basic prompts to summarize data and draft systems.  

• Have High Discernment: You know when a process doesn't make sense and needs to be updated.  





Preferred Qualifications  



• Hands-on experience with Hospitable (highly preferred).  

• Experience managing or scaling a portfolio of multiple properties.  

• Experience sourcing or managing vendors in the home trade sector (cleaning, maintenance, landscaping, or similar).  

• Familiarity with QuickBooks, CRM platforms, or OpenPhone.  

• Spanish fluency is a plus (for vendor coordination).  



 

What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days  



• Vendor coordination runs smoothly with minimal founder involvement.  

• A centralized “SOP Library” is documented and being utilized.  

• Operational tasks are tracked in a clear, transparent dashboard.  

• A growing bench of new, vetted vendors is in place across key trade categories.  

• The founder is focused on growth and partnerships, confident that the “machine” is running.  



 

Compensation & Schedule 



• Hourly Rate: $8–13/hr (based on experience)  

• Schedule: Wednesday–Monday, aligned with peak guest stays, with the opportunity to increase hours as the business scales  

• Full-Time: 30–40 hrs/week  



To Apply  

Kindly fill out the application form:

title: Referral Partnership Coordinator — Bank Outreach (Phone Role)
description:
**Referral Partnership Coordinator — Bank Outreach (Full-Time, Remote)**



**Read this first**

This is a phone job. You will spend most of your day making outbound calls to banks and credit unions in the United States — roughly 30 to 50 calls a day. If you are looking for quiet admin work, data entry, or social media management, this is not the right role for you.



**About us**

Architect Advisory Enterprises is a consulting firm based in Houston, Texas. We advise business owners on lending, financial systems, and scaling. We are building a nationwide database of business bankers, and you would own that project end to end.



**What you'll actually do**

- Call banks, credit unions, and CDFIs and get through to the business banker or BDO — not the retail teller, not the branch manager

- Introduce our firm, build a real relationship, and get the banker talking

- Run a short script to capture their lending products, credit and revenue requirements, SBA participation, territory, and referral process

- Log every call and every detail in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Re-call the same institution to reach a second banker at a different branch and confirm the information matches

- Flag bad data, disconnected numbers, and bankers who have moved on

- Send a short weekly summary: who was reached, what was learned, who needs follow-up



You are not selling anything. Nobody is being pitched. You are introducing our firm and finding out how each banker's lending works.



**What we're looking for**

- You sound confident and warm on the phone. This is the number one requirement.

- You are comfortable with gatekeepers. "We don't have a business banker" is the start of a conversation, not the end of one.

- Excellent spoken and written English (C1 or C2)

- Experience with a CRM. GoHighLevel is a plus, not required.

- Obsessive about accuracy — a wrong name or title in this database costs us a real relationship

- Available 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday. Banks are only open when we call them, so this is not negotiable.

- Reliable internet, a working headset, and a quiet place to make calls

- Strong plus: background in banking, lending, mortgage, insurance, or outbound BPO sales



**Details**

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $1,000 to $1,200 per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Paid training on our script and CRM



**To apply**

Use the subject line "Partnerships — [Your Name]".



In your message, answer all five:

1. You call a bank's main line and ask for the business banker. The receptionist says, "We don't have one." What do you say next? Give us your exact words.

2. What CRM tools have you used, and how did you keep a large contact list clean and free of duplicates?

3. Describe a time you found an error in a list or database. How did you catch it?

4. Confirm you can work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time.

5. Confirm you have a headset, reliable internet, and a quiet place to call from.



**Also required:** include a short voice or video recording (60 seconds is plenty) answering question 1 out loud. We need to hear how you sound on the phone.



Applications without the correct subject line and a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Shorts Editor for Gaming Streams (No Experience Required if Talented)
description:

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:

/SMS automations, social media channels, and marketing systems in place. We are not starting from scratch.



We are looking for someone who can come in, **audit what we already have, identify gaps, and help us close those gaps so the business is ready to scale.**

* Audit our existing Shopify store and identify opportunities for improvement

* Improve product pages for conversion

* Organize and optimize collections

* Identify missing or inconsistent product images/content

* Review mobile experience and site usability

* Recommend and implement CRO improvements

*
 & SMS / Klaviyo**

* Identify gaps or missed revenue opportunities

* Improve segmentation and targeting

* Review
/SMS capture strategy

* Klaviyo
 and SMS marketing

* Product page and collection optimization

* Apparel or fashion ecommerce experience preferred

### When Applying

1. Links to Shopify stores you have worked on

2. Specific examples of improvements you made

3. Any measurable results you achieved, such as increased conversion rate, AOV,
 revenue, ROAS, or overall sales

4. Your experience with Klaviyo

5. Your experience with Meta Ads, if applicable

title: Learning and Development Assistant
description:
Job Summary:



The Assistant to the Learning and Development Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and logistical support to the Learning and Development Coordinator in carrying out the firm’s training and compliance programs. Reporting directly to the Learning and Development Coordinator, this role assists with scheduling training sessions, preparing and organizing training materials, entering and updating records in the Learning Management System (LMS), and tracking employee progress toward completion. The assistant helps ensure that training activities run smoothly and that records remain accurate and current, escalating issues to the Coordinator as needed.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Material Preparation and Support:

- Provide support to the Coordinator in preparing and formatting training materials, including presentations, handouts, e-learning modules, and compliance-related resources.

- Help keep training content current by making edits and updates under the direction of the Coordinator.

- Assist in updating training materials to reflect changes in regulations, compliance requirements, and firm procedures as directed.



2. Training Scheduling and Logistics:

- Assist the Coordinator in scheduling and organizing internal and external training sessions, workshops, and seminars.

- Provide logistical support during training programs, including preparing rooms, materials, and sign-in sheets, and helping sessions run smoothly.

- Help set up in-person training spaces and assist with virtual platforms for remote training sessions.



3. Tracking Training Modules and Completion:

- Enter and update training modules in the firm’s Learning Management System (LMS) under the Coordinator’s direction, ensuring content is accessible and current.

- Monitor and record employee progress in completing mandatory and elective training modules, flagging incomplete courses to the Coordinator.

- Compile training completion data and notify the Coordinator of employees who may be falling behind or approaching compliance deadlines.



4. Compliance Tracking and Recordkeeping:

- Maintain accurate records of employee compliance with training requirements.

- Assist the Coordinator in preparing compliance reports, highlighting any outstanding or overdue training for review.



5. Onboarding Training Support:

- Assist the Coordinator in organizing onboarding training materials so that new employees receive required training on firm policies, legal compliance, and specific role-related tasks.

- Track new hire progress through onboarding training modules and notify the Coordinator when required training is not completed within the probationary period.



6. Employee Support and Communication:

- Serve as an initial point of contact for routine employee questions about training modules, compliance expectations, or LMS access, escalating complex issues to the Coordinator.

- Help employees navigate the training system, answer basic questions about course requirements, and troubleshoot common access or technical issues.



7. Feedback and Administrative Support:

- Distribute and collect feedback surveys from training participants and compile the results for the Coordinator.

- Assist in organizing training and compliance data to support the Coordinator’s review of training outcomes.

- Provide general administrative support to the Coordinator on training-related projects and initiatives.



Qualifications:

- High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree (or progress toward one) in Business Administration, Communication, Education, or a related field preferred.

- 1 year of administrative, clerical, or support experience; exposure to a learning and development or legal environment is a plus.

- Basic familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), or a willingness to learn.

- Comfort with data entry and maintaining accurate, organized records.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines under supervision.

- High attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping and reporting.

- Proficiency in Mac, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

title: Remote Linux Server Support Technician
description:
A US-based technology services company (details kept confidential until final selection) is hiring a part-time remote server support technician to help maintain a small fleet of Linux cloud servers running containerized applications. You will handle routine maintenance, monitoring, backups, updates, and first-line troubleshooting under the direction of the owner (US-based).

Work arrangement: Fully remote, 10–15 hours/week to start, flexible schedule with a required weekly maintenance window and same-day response on critical alerts during agreed hours.

Required Skills

Area What we need

Linux administration Ubuntu Server: users/permissions, systemd services, package management, cron, log analysis (journalctl, /var/log), resource troubleshooting (CPU/RAM/disk)

Docker & Docker Compose Deploy, update, restart, and debug multi-container stacks; read/write compose files; manage volumes and networks

PostgreSQL Routine admin: dumps/restores (pg_dump), user/role management, verifying backup integrity

Reverse proxy & TLS Caddy or Nginx: virtual hosts, automatic HTTPS/Let’s Encrypt renewal, redirect rules

Firewall & hardening UFW/iptables, SSH key-only authentication, fail2ban, disabling root login, least-privilege user setup

Monitoring & alerting Uptime Kuma (or Prometheus/Grafana): configuring checks, alert channels, status pages

Backups & disaster recovery Scripted backups (bash + cron), off-server copies (rsync/rclone/object storage), and — critically — performing actual restore drills, not just assuming backups work

DNS management A/CNAME records, TTLs, subdomains, nameserver changes (Cloudflare experience preferred)

Bash scripting Write and maintain small maintenance/backup scripts; read and modify existing scripts safely

Git Clone, commit, push — all configuration changes are tracked in a private repository

Documentation & English Clear written English; every task ends with updated notes. If it isn’t documented, it didn’t happen

Nice to Have (not required)

• Experience with self-hosted workflow-automation tools

• Experience with transactional
 services and deliverability basics

• Familiarity with budget VPS providers (InterServer, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr)

• Basic understanding of webhook-based application integrations

• Any security coursework or certifications (e.g., RHCSA, CompTIA Security+)

What This Role Does NOT Include

• No access to customer billing, payment systems, or financial accounts

• No direct contact with customers

• No access to third-party vendor dashboards or account credentials (those remain with the owner)

• No root access — you work from a dedicated, least-privilege admin account

• No 24/7 on-call expectation — alerts during agreed hours with a defined escalation path

How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

1. A 60–90 second voice recording: introduce yourself and talk about your technical skills and experience — what systems you’ve administered, what you’re best at, and the kind of work you enjoy. (This is your audition — speak naturally, no reading from a script.)

2. A short written answer (5–10 sentences): “A server’s disk fills up at 2 AM and a critical service stops. Walk me through exactly what you do, step by step.” (This shows us how you think and how you write.)

3. Any proof of hands-on work: GitHub profile, scripts you’ve written, a homelab description, or certifications

4. Your internet speed test result and your backup plan for power/internet outages

5. Your expected monthly salary and your available weekly hours. Salary is based on experience — tell us your number and what justifies it.

title: Omni-Channel Operations Manager & Executive Assistant
description:
Core Objective: Take full ownership of multi-channel operations, stabilize and scale non-Amazon growth channels, and manage a continuous, proactive import supply chain to eliminate stock-outs.

________________________________________



Role Overview & Impact



We are an established e-commerce business seeking a high-level operational partner to serve as our executive point person. While our Amazon storefront is highly stable and optimized, we are actively expanding our sales velocity across alternative marketplaces, including Walmart, Home Depot, eBay, and our own website.



Virtually all of our inventory consists of imports from the Far East. We need a brilliant, analytical organizer to tie up daily operational loose ends, run rigorous multi-channel inventory forecasting, and act as an executive gatekeeper for the business owner.

________________________________________



Core Responsibilities



1. Continuous Inventory Control & Supply Chain Management

    • Data-Driven Forecasting: Build and maintain an advanced inventory tracking system that continuously calculates multi-channel sales velocity and safety stock levels.

    • Lead-Time Optimization: Proactively manage complex Far East production timelines, sea freight schedules, customs clearance, and 3PL receiving delays.

    • Proactive Purchase Orders: Generate and submit accurate purchase orders well ahead of manufacturing lead times to entirely eliminate channel stockouts.

    • Multi-Channel Stock Allocation: Continuously monitor and distribute stock positions between Amazon FBA and multi-channel fulfillment nodes to prevent listing suppressions on alternative platforms.

    • Logistics Liaison: Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Far East manufacturers and freight forwarders.



2. Non-Amazon Channel Growth & Operations

    • Channel Expansion: Take ownership of tracking, updating, and driving sales velocity on Walmart, Home Depot, eBay, and our direct website.

    • Catalog Governance: Maintain strict oversight of product data sheets, attribute mapping, and listing health across all enterprise marketplaces.

    • Operational Triage: Audit all platforms daily for broken listings, pricing mismatches, and compliance errors to maximize channel uptime.



3. Executive Support & Inbox Gatekeeping

    • Inbox Triage: Manage the business owner's executive
 inbox daily. Clean out noise, independently resolve standard operational or supplier inquiries, and organize critical messages for quick executive review.

    • Calendar Management: Ensure the business owner's daily schedule is optimized, coordinating with external vendors and scheduling meetings to protect executive strategic time.

    • Process Standardization: Document all inventory tracking, ordering steps, and daily platform maintenance routines into standardized SOPs.

________________________________________



Work Style & Dynamic Prioritization

    • Agile Context-Switching: This position requires a balance between structured, deep-focus tasks (like calculating inventory lead times) and rapid problem-solving when unexpected marketplace issues arise on Walmart or Home Depot.

    • Day-to-Day Variety: While inventory control is your core anchor, your daily focus will shift based on business needs—one day you may be mapping catalog attributes for a new platform, and the next you may be auditing shipping discrepancies.

    • Autonomous Triage: You must excel at assessing a long list of "loose ends," identifying which tasks are urgent vs. important, and restructuring your day without needing constant executive direction.

________________________________________

Position Requirements

    • Experience: 3+ years of direct experience managing multi-channel e-commerce operations (Amazon + Walmart/Home Depot/eBay).

    • Supply Chain Skills: Proven track record calculating burn rates, managing safety stock, and navigating Far East import lead times.

    • Data Mastery: Expert-level Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills (advanced formulas for forecasting and data reconciliation).

    • Communication: Exceptional written English for professional vendor and executive communication.

    • Traits: High level of business acumen, extreme attention to detail, and a history of long-term dedication and loyalty with previous employers.

________________________________________

 Application Instructions (Mandatory Screening Task)



To be considered for this role, please start your cover letter response with the word "FORECAST" in all caps, and include a brief, 3-sentence answer to this operational scenario:



"We sell a product that moves 50 units a day on Amazon and 10 units a day on Home Depot. Our manufacturer in the Far East takes 45 days to produce an order, and sea shipping takes another 35 days. If we currently have 4,000 units in total stock across all locations, in how many days must we submit our next Purchase Order to avoid a stock-out? Walk us through your basic logic."



Applications that do not include the keyword or do not attempt the math logic problem may be automatically disqualified.
